jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Scale
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------


At Affinity, we're passionate about our customers' success and looking for a resourceful, results driven Customer Success Specialist to join our Scale team. This role blends two things: managing a large, global portfolio of Scale customers day to day, and helping build the scalable, one to many programs that let a lean team deliver a great experience across a much larger book than a traditional 1:1 CSM model allows.


You'll manage a book of Scale accounts as part of a pooled model, driving adoption, mitigating renewal risk, and expanding revenue, while also building the playbooks, programs, triggers, and campaigns that not only support activation for the Scale book, but also for the whole customer base. You'll partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Product, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the customer journey feels coordinated from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

**Account management**

* Manage a large and global portfolio of customers, including CRM workflow support, renewal risk, and revenue expansion opportunities.
* Leverage high touch and one to many tactics to drive positive customer outcomes and help users work Affinity into their daily tech stack.
* Mitigate risk by proactively identifying and flagging churn risk early in the contract cycle.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product and make workflow recommendations to drive adoption and engagement.
* Proactively identify customers who may not be maximizing Affinity and engage them to drive up monthly active users and seat expansion.
* Work cross functionally to provide effective and productive customer engagements.
* Function as the voice of the customer, identifying trends and feeding them back internally.

**Program design and journey work**

* Help design and continuously improve programs across the Scale customer journey, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Help identify which moments need a scaled, tech touch program versus a 1:1 touch, and build the playbooks and triggers (health score, usage signals, journey stage) that route accounts appropriately.
* Use product usage and health score data to build programs that increase adoption of core Affinity features and AI capabilities, including MCP, across the Scale book.
* Help identify the highest leverage touchpoints and design campaigns, in app messaging, and outreach sequences that move accounts through activation milestones.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Take a data first approach to designing and implementing engagement strategies at scale.
* Track the KPIs that matter for the Scale segment (activation rate, adoption, retention, expansion ARR, GRR) and report regularly on program and portfolio performance.
* Share insights that help shape Affinity's overall scale strategy.

**How you'll work**
-------------------

* Partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Onboarding, Product, and Lifecycle so the customer journey feels coordinated rather than duplicated across teams.
* Use data (Salesforce, Amplitude, etc.) to prioritize which accounts need attention and which programs to build next.
* Build with AI and automation first, using triggers and personalization to make one to many programs feel tailored.
* Operate with the pace and iteration mindset of a hyper growth CS org: ship a program, measure it, adjust it.
* Orchestrate cross functional resources to ensure the success of your clients.

**Qualifications**
------------------


Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Affinity, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align with the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Required**

* 1\-2 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, CS programs, CS operations, Lifecycle Marketing, or similar role.
* Track record of achieving commercial targets and goals, preferably in an enterprise SaaS setting.
* Experience managing high volumes of accounts at scale, driving adoption and renewals.
* Experience designing or running scalable, tech touch programs for a large book of accounts, not just 1:1 account management.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a history of building strong business relationships.
* A clear communicator, comfortable presenting your work to teammates and cross functional partners.
* Skilled at analyzing customer and usage data to build actionable programs and measure outcomes.
* Proficient in organization, account prioritization, project management, and time management.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and programs simultaneously, and ship in a fast paced, high growth environment.
* You are excited by the startup environment and enjoy contributing to a team that's still building out its structure and process as it scales.

**Nice to have**

* Experience at a SaaS company in the CRM or data services space.
* Experience with financial services clients, or in VC, private equity, investment banking, or other private capital verticals.
* Proficiency with tools like Salesforce, AI first CS platforms like Sonora, marketing automation tools like Customer.io or Pardot, Notion, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar).
* Familiarity with Affinity's MCP / AI ecosystem or similar AI driven CS tooling.
* A creative problem solver who challenges the status quo, with a curiosity for data and a habit of digging into results to surface trends.

**Location: San Francisco or New York**

*For this role we're embracing a hub\-hybrid model, designed to balance flexibility with meaningful in\-person collaboration. Team members within commuting distance are expected in\-office 2 days per week, typically Tuesday through Thur

Fortinet’s mission is to deliver the most innovative, highest\-performing network security fabric to secure and simplify IT infrastructures. We are a leading global provider of Network Security Solutions for carriers, datacenters, enterprises, and distributed offices. We have proven to be a truly innovative technology driven network Security Company with over 1400 registered Global Patents.

* Prospecting into multiple organizations via calling, networking and e\-mail, with the help of cutting\-edge digital platforms for intent based leads such as Bombora and 6Sense, and contact discovery using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Discover.org, and other digital tools and Internet sources, to build and maintain a high\-quality lead pipeline.
* Schedule well qualified appointments with key decision makers within targeted companies.
* Meet and exceed daily and weekly call goals, as well as deliver a high quantity of well qualified sales opportunities.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative II - IP&E
jobs.description:
**Position:**  

Inside Sales Representative II \- IPE
  
  

**Job Description:**  

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30\.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.
  
  

Arrow brings technology solutions to a breadth of markets, including telecommunications, information systems, transportation, medical, industrial, and consumer electronics. Arrow provides specialized services and expertise across the entire product lifecycle. Arrow does this by connecting customers to the right technology at the right place, time, and price. Arrow provides extraordinary value to customers and suppliers \- the best technology companies in the world \- and connects them through the companys industry\-leading services.
  
  

As an IPE Inside Sales Representative, you will be selling Arrow’s line card of passive, electromechanical, and connector products, and be the daily contact for customers and suppliers.
  
  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**  

* Managing the overall account relationship by providing strategic service and support to the assigned customer base. Maximize margins, gain market share, and drive value\-added solution selling.
* Working with internal and external resources, provide customer service, often facilitating work of others in quoting, fulfilling demand, ensuring on\-time delivery of orders, providing engineering support, and troubleshooting other customer problems.
* Functioning as key liaison between suppliers and customers to build and establish long\-term business partnerships for Arrow.
* Responsible for Sales Excellence through the development and management of customer strategy in assigned account territory.
* Sell and drive Solutions Selling within the approved account level strategy. Requires knowledge of the competitive landscape in the market and the ability to make sales decisions based on that information.
* Responsible for on\-going Sales Support activities for the Order to Invoice process. Owns the customer interface for backend Quality processes: corrective actions, Field Quality Reports. Owns and Maintains Perfect Order Index (POI) and Inventory integrity to minimize write\-offs/bill backs.
* Owns the customer interface for important Credit and Financial Information as well as coordination of all available resources and support functions.
* As owner of the overall customer Quote to Order sales objectives, set strategy for the quote process, coordinate resources and processing of customer quotations (Quote Center, Quote Cover Sheet, PM Views, Management, FSR, Suppliers, Value Add, and SSG), validate EOL and item class change (NCNR), negotiate pricing and Quote markup (owns strategy and application) and notify the customer of all/any price increases.
* This job profile requires the assignment and participation in a sales compensation plan. A portion of OTE will be variable and tied to specific sales\-related goals as set forth by Arrow.


**What We Are Looking For:**  

* 4\-5 years’ experience in electronics distribution; experience in passive electronic component sales strongly preferred (Power Supplies, Cable assemblies, Thermal, Connectors, Magnetics, Capacitors/Resistors
* Systems savvy, ability to adapt quickly. Proficiency in MS Office Suite, advanced Excel skills (XLookup, Macros, etc.) a plus
* Ability to build influential relationships
* The ability to work collaboratively with internal and external resources to generate results
* Strong communication, negotiating, and organization skills
* Strong customer service and sales skills.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About the Role**


Premier Global Links LLC is hiring a **Junior Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help build and scale outbound sales development for an AI\-powered CAD technology company serving the manufacturing and engineering market.


This is an early\-career opportunity for a strong communicator who enjoys research, writing, outreach, and starting conversations with prospective customers. You will work closely with product and leadership teams to identify target accounts, develop personalized messaging, and create qualified sales opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and build target account lists across manufacturing, machine shops, and hardware companies.
* Identify relevant prospects and decision\-makers using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, CRM, and other prospecting tools.
* Write concise, personalized outbound emails and messages.
* Conduct outbound prospecting and initiate conversations with potential customers.
* Qualify early interest and route qualified opportunities to the product or sales team.
* Track outreach activity, responses, and pipeline information in the CRM.
* Test different messaging and prospecting approaches and improve based on results.
* Collaborate with product and leadership teams to stay current on product capabilities and customer messaging.
* Help develop repeatable outbound sales and prospecting processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* New graduate or early\-career professional; **0–6 months of SDR/BDR experience** is acceptable.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to write short, clear, personalized outreach.
* Comfortable with outbound prospecting, follow\-ups, and handling rejection.
* Curious and motivated to learn about AI, CAD, manufacturing, and engineering technology.
* Able to understand technical products and communicate their business value clearly.
* Strong research, organization, persistence, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work **fully on\-site in San Francisco, CA**.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent educational background; no specific major required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship or early experience at a startup or early\-stage company.
* Experience with outbound sales or prospecting tools such as **Apollo, Clay, Outreach, HubSpot, Salesforce, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator**.
* Exposure to manufacturing, mechanical engineering, CAD, robotics, hardware, machining, or related fields.
* Experience creating writing samples such as newsletters, blogs, articles, or other published content.
* Demonstrated achievement in academics, sports, entrepreneurship, projects, or other competitive environments.

**Compensation**

* **Base Salary:** $65,000–$70,000 annually
* **On\-Target Earnings (OTE):** $90,000–$100,000
* Full\-time, on\-site position
* San Francisco, CA

**Work Environment**


This position is designed for an early\-career professional who wants hands\-on experience in **sales development, AI technology, manufacturing, and startup growth**. You will have the opportunity to help build outbound prospecting processes and contribute directly to early customer acquisition efforts.

**Premier Global Links LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

jobs.title: Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**


As a **Business Sales Representative \- Strategic Accounts,** you will own and grow a portfolio of complex, high\-growth Medium Business customers while developing new opportunities across assigned accounts. These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. This is a strategic, quota\-carrying outside sales role for an experienced B2B seller who can balance account maintenance, service coordination, prospecting, pipeline creation, and complex solution selling. You will work closely with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, and cross\-functional teams to help customers evaluate technology choices, solve business challenges, and invest in solutions that support long\-term growth. This role is designed for sellers who are technical, resourceful, disciplined, and comfortable competing in a sophisticated market where customers have more choices than ever.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance\-based commission tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from** **$121,100 – $154,100****.** If you are motivated by ownership, measurable goals, and the ability to increase your income through performance, this role is designed for you.

**What you’ll do**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Own and grow Platinum level accounts.** Build account plans that prioritize retention, expansion, new opportunity creation, customer relationship depth, and long\-term revenue growth.
* **Balance service and sales priorities.** Manage account maintenance and customer service needs while protecting time for prospecting, pipeline development, and closing new business.
* **Create and manage strategic pipelines.** Generate opportunities through account mapping, executive outreach, referrals, partner collaboration, customer expansion plays, and targeted prospecting.
* **Navigate complex technical solutions.** Learn and position wired, mobility, connectivity, and advanced technology solutions while translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* **Orchestrate internal and partner resources.** Collaborate with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, product specialists, and support teams to design and deliver the right customer solution.
* **Differentiate in a competitive market.** Compete against direct providers, indirect competitors, vendors, resellers, and internal channel overlap by selling value, relationship, expertise, and business impact.
* **Lead a consultative sales process.** Diagnosing customer needs, uncover growth opportunities, overcome objections, and build solutions aligned to operational, technology, and financial priorities.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM and forecast accuracy.** Track pipeline, account activity, deal stage, next steps, expected close timing, and revenue impact with consistency and accuracy.
* **Protect customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted business advisor who can coordinate across service, sales, technical, and partner resources to help customers succeed.

 **What you’ll Bring**

* 5\+ years of successful outside B2B sales experience, preferably with complex accounts, telecommunications, technology, SaaS, mobility, wired solutions, or business services.
* Documented success meeting or exceeding quota in a full\-cycle sales role that required prospecting, account growth, negotiation, and closing.
* Ability to manage both sales and account\-maintenance demands without losing focus on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex product sets, internal processes, wired and mobility terminology, and solution\-design concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to work through internal teams, sales engineers, partner channels, and cross\-functional resources to solve customer problems.
* Strong territory, account planning, pipeline management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline.
* Comfortable competing in a market where customers evaluate multiple providers, vendors, resellers, and channel options.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation for market coverage.

Biomics Inc. is seeking talented, motivated, and results\-driven sales professionals to help launch and grow our innovative nucleic acid extraction product line. **Key Responsibilities**

The sales professional will be responsible for identifying, contacting, and developing customers in the cfDNA, liquid biopsy, molecular diagnostics, NGS, oncology research, and life science research markets.

Responsibilities include:

* Promote and sell products to academic, clinical research, biotech, pharma, CRO, and diagnostic customers.
* Develop new customer accounts and manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing.
* Build relationships with principal investigators, lab managers, procurement teams, molecular biology labs, and commercial testing organizations.
* Work with customers to understand their nucleic acid extraction challenges and position our products as a differentiated solution.
* Support distributor and channel development when needed.
* Provide customer feedback to Biomics’ product development and marketing teams.
* Represent Biomics at conferences, trade shows, webinars, and customer meetings.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are especially interested in candidates with experience selling products related to:

* Nucleic acid extraction and purification
* cfDNA / liquid biopsy
* PCR, qPCR, ddPCR, NGS, or molecular diagnostics
* Sample preparation kits
* Life science reagents and consumables
* Oncology research or translational medicine

A strong candidate should have:

* Prior experience with sales in the healthcare, pharma, biotech, and/or medical devices/consumables space
* Ability to communicate technical product advantages clearly.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working with an emerging technology company.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and customer\-development skills.

**Compensation**

Biomics offers a flexible compensation structure, which may include:

* Base salary of $120,000 plus commission (industry\-standard rates)
* Commission\-based sales partnership
* Territory\-based sales role
* Performance bonus
* Equity or long\-term incentive potential for exceptional candidates

Compensation will be based on experience, network, territory, and expected contribution.

This is an opportunity to join at the early commercial stage of a potentially disruptive nucleic acid purification platform. The successful candidate will have the chance to help build the market for products across cfDNA, RNA, genomic DNA, pathogen nucleic acids, and other sample\-preparation applications.

**To apply, please send your resume and a brief introduction to:** **hr2@biomicsinc.com**

Pay: From $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible spending account
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Union City, CA 94587

We practice Beneficial Banking™ by investing in social and environmental impact, prioritizing transparency, and expanding access to equitable financial products, all in pursuit of a banking system that is regenerative for the planet and equitable for all. Together, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the communities where we live and work, creating positive impact through partnership, service, and shared success.
  
  

POSITION OVERVIEW
  
The Treasury \& Client Services Associate (TCSA) provides comprehensive operational and client support to Commercial Banking teams and commercial clients across business, personal, and commercial deposit products. This role serves as a primary point of contact for client servicing inquiries and service requests, delivering timely and professional support through phone, email, and in\-person interactions.
  
The TCSA is responsible for onboarding new client relationships, including collecting and reviewing required documentation, completing account setup, and ensuring accuracy and completeness of all new account records. The role plays a critical part in safeguarding the Bank by applying risk assessment protocols, adhering to regulatory requirements, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and procedures to mitigate operational, reputational, and audit risk.
  
Acting as a subject matter resource, the TCSA maintains working knowledge of deposit products, cash management services, and related systems, including Online Banking, ACH, wire transfers, EFTPS payments, and Remote Deposit Capture. The role supports relationship banking efforts by delivering high\-quality client service, assisting with client onboarding, and identifying potential opportunities to deepen existing .relationships for referral to relationship managers or Treasury Management Advisors.
  
The TCSA collaborates closely with Treasury Management Advisors, Client \& Treasury Managers, and other internal partners to support daily operations and enhance the client experience. This position includes oversight of assigned operational processes and requires strict adherence to compliance standards in all account\-related activities and client communications.
  
This position is represented by a union. Employment in this role is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable collective bargaining agreement, including union membership requirements and/or dues or fees, where applicable.

Client Service \& Relationship Support
  
* Provide direct support to commercial clients through phone, email, and in\-person interactions, delivering timely and professional service.
* Assist in fostering a strong client\-centric culture by identifying potential cross\-selling opportunities aligned to client.needs and referring them to relationship managers or Treasury Management Advisors.
* Support relationship management efforts by participating in client interactions, including joint calls, relationship reviews, and client training sessions, as.appropriate; product demonstrations and advisory discussions are led by Treasury Management Advisors or relationship managers.
* Promote and maintain positive working relationships with internal partners and external clients to support overall service excellence.


Treasury Management \& Sales Support
  
* Support Treasury Management Advisors and Client \& Treasury leadership with pre\-call research and proposal preparation, including pricing and post\-sales documentation.
* Assist in gathering and organizing prospective client information to support product recommendations and proposal development prepared by Treasury Management Advisors and relationship managers.
* Contribute to client onboarding and relationship deepening efforts by supporting product education and service adoption.
* Reinforce treasury management ,service information and client training provided by Treasury Management Advisors, including associated risks, requirements, and best practices.


Account Onboarding, Documentation \& Servicing
  
* Prepare account documentation, product agreements, and supporting legal forms for new and existing client relationships.
* Collect, review, and validate required documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy of account setup and maintenance requests.
* Perform account servicing activities, including account openings, maintenance, transfers, and check orders, in accordance with established procedures.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Location:** Sunnyvale, CA


**Experience:** 0\-3 Years


**Position:** 4 days in office in Sunnyvale


**About us:**

Fortinet’s mission is to deliver the most innovative, highest\-performing network security fabric to secure and simplify IT infrastructures. We are a leading global provider of Network Security Solutions for carriers, datacenters, enterprises, and distributed offices. We have proven to be a truly innovative technology driven network Security Company with over 1400 registered Global Patents.


We are looking for a talented, driven, and self\-motivated individual to join us as Business Development Representative. Fortinet is welcoming recent college graduates and are ready to thrive in a fast\-paced environment! As an Entry\-level Business Development Representative, you will have the opportunity to learn about the industry, and set the foundation for career advancement.


**As a BDR, you will:**

* Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fortinet’s technology in order to articulate our value proposition to decision\-makers, as well as being able to successfully manage and overcome objections.
* Research customers, identify decision makers, educate prospects and qualify buying interest and sense of urgency.
* Prospecting into multiple organizations via calling, networking and e\-mail, with the help of cutting\-edge digital platforms for intent based leads such as Bombora and 6Sense, and contact discovery using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Discover.org, and other digital tools and Internet sources, to build and maintain a high\-quality lead pipeline.
* Schedule well qualified appointments with key decision makers within targeted companies.
* Meet and exceed daily and weekly call goals, as well as deliver a high quantity of well qualified sales opportunities.
* Maintain accurate activity, contact, and account information of all customers and prospects in our CRM (Salesforce).
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing and other Fortinet business functions in the development of strategic sales approaches.

**Requirements:**

* Self\-starter with positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills; ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities
* Excellent organization skills, attention to detail, customer focus, curiosity and highly data\-driven are musts Basic knowledge in IT or cybersecurity
* Ability to work in a high\-energy sales team environment; phenomenal and collaborative teammate

**What you can expect from us:**

* On the job and formal online training and development opportunities, with the possibility to get the industry recognized certifications.
* An excellent role to start a career in enterprise technology sales, with opportunities to get involved with marketing, technology operations and sales
* Employee days to meet and learn about our key sponsorships and events

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.


Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $55,000 \- $70,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.


All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40\+ sources, and execute personalized, multi\-channel outreach—all from a single AI\-powered workspace.  

  

Trusted by some of the most innovative go\-to\-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to **90% time savings** on list building and **19% higher output per rep**.  

  

We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast\-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**
------------------


As one of our early Sales Development Representative, you'll be on the forefront of driving Unify’s growth by generating new business opportunities through strategic outreach and engagement. This role is for someone who is hyper focused on delivering results and understands that this often requires constant, independent process innovation. In addition to helping carry out critical business initiatives with the GTM team, you’ll gain a ton of technical exposure working closely with our product \+ engineering team to deliver key market insights/feedback as we rapidly ship new features. Within a small team like ours, every contribution you make has a direct impact on the company's growth trajectory.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to CEO
jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**



From an idea in one man's garage to an essential in every man's shower, Every Man Jack was created to give men everywhere clean, effective personal care that stands up to any adventure.  

  

Born in 2007 at the base of Mt. Tam, near the great redwood forests of Northern California, Every Man Jack was founded to fill a gap in the men's care space. To remove the bravado and harsh chemicals that choked the industry, and focus instead on simple, clean products accessible to regular guys.  

  

That belief is right in our name: the phrase “Every Man Jack” traces its origins back several centuries, when it meant “everybody without exception.”  

  

Today it still means quality within reach. It stands for the man who fixes what's broken, who builds, and who welcomes the unknown. We're for the man whose routine belongs on the trail, in the surf, and under open skies. He's ready for the next story worth remembering.  

  

**WHAT WE DO**



Every Man Jack, a B Corp Certified Company, is a leader in the natural men's grooming space, with a presence across major national retailers like Target, Walmart, Whole Foods, and Amazon.  

  

We've experienced significant growth over the past several years and continue to add top talent to our growing roster.  

  

Considering a host of recent initiatives, significant retail distribution opportunities, and high growth e\-commerce initiatives, there is no shortage of exciting projects for the Every Man Jack team.

* Perform administrative work responsibly and in a timely manner, exercising considerable independence and sound judgment in making decisions.
* Ensure the executive(s) has appropriate meals planned, tackling everything from delivery/pick\-up to reservations.

  


**LEADERSHIP TEAM (LT) \+ BOARD**


* Coordinate and attend LT meetings; manage agendas and meeting materials, capture key decisions and action items, and track follow\-up with accountable owners.

jobs.title: Lead, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000\+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

**Why would you love this job?**
--------------------------------


Redis is the platform developers trust for real\-time data—and the platform an increasing share of AI applications are built on. Now, the audience discovering and evaluating Redis is no longer exclusively human. AI agents can identify a need, decide which solution fits, review technical documentation, and create a new account within one continuous session.


The Lead, Growth Marketing owns the Redis digital surface for both agents and humans. This includes the website, SEO, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, conversion\-rate optimization, and the measurement system that connects discovery to pipeline, account creation, and activation.


Your central challenge is to streamline agent\-led growth: making Redis easy for agents to discover, understand, recommend, evaluate, and select while ensuring the same digital experience converts human developers and buyers.


This is a hands\-on strategic leadership role for a builder who wants to create a new kind of digital growth system at a high\-growth, pre\-IPO company. You’ll define the strategy, direct external specialists, contribute to the highest\-priority work, measure the outcomes, and continuously improve the system with data.


You should be as comfortable presenting a strategy to executives as you are opening an AI tool and building a working campaign prototype from a blank page in 30 minutes.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own the Redis digital surface**. Set the strategy for how agents and humans discover, understand, evaluate, and convert across Redis’s website, documentation pathways, organic presence, and AI surfaces.
* **Lead agent\-driven growth**. Build a low\-friction journey in which an agent can identify the right Redis solution, review the relevant documentation, and create an account in a single session.
* **Own SEO, AEO, and GEO.** Establish the strategy for search engines, AI answer engines, generative search, assistants, and coding agents so Redis is accurately represented, cited, recommended, and selected.
* **Own website strategy.** Define the platform story, information architecture, page priorities, content pathways, and contextual\-conversion model. Partner with web engineering on implementation and feasibility.
* **Lead CRO and experimentation**. Maintain a rigorous testing roadmap across high\-intent pages, documentation journeys, sign\-up flows, and other critical conversion points.
* **Build the measurement system**. Connect human and agent discovery to meaningful outcomes, including visibility, citations, recommendations, documentation engagement, account creation, conversion, activation, and pipeline.
* **Turn data into action.** Use performance data to improve the strategy, prioritize the roadmap, reallocate resources, and decide what to scale, revise, or stop.
* **Direct external specialists**. Set priorities and scopes of work for contractors and an agency partner, review output, and redirect capacity as business needs change.
* **Align the digital growth engine**. Partner with content, developer relations, product, engineering, paid media, and executive leadership so Redis presents one connected path from discovery to adoption.

**What you’ll need to have**
----------------------------

* Typically 7\+ years in digital growth or GTM marketing, including meaningful experience inside high\-growth B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or AI\-adjacent companies.
* A record of building or materially improving digital growth systems where the strategy and operating model were not already fully defined.
* Deep experience owning website strategy, digital conversion, and organic growth—not simply supporting those functions.
* Experience developing integrated SEO, AEO, or GEO strategies across traditional search, generative search, AI assistants, answer engines, or coding agents.
* An understanding of how content, documentation, citations, authority, structured information, and technical foundations influence AI recommendations and technology selection.
* Experience defining measurement for emerging digital journeys, including the ability to connect leading signals to account creation, activation, pipeline, or revenue.
* Direct ownership of a CRO and experimentation program, with strong analytical and statistical judgment.
* Experience defining email and GTM\-orchestration strategy while directing specialists who handle implementation and ongoing operations.
* Demonstrated use of AI tools and agents to research, plan, build, analyze, or optimize marketing programs.
* AI\-native operating fluency: you can rapidly turn a business objective into a credible campaign, journey, or workflow prototype and then improve it with judgment and data.
* Experience directing contractors and agency\-staffed specialists, including scoping work, setting priorities, reviewing output, and reallocating capacity.
* Strong executive communication and the willingness to move between strategy and hands\-on work.

**We give back to our employees:**


Our culture is what makes Redis a fun and rewarding place to work. To support you at work and beyond, we offer all our US team members fantastic benefits and perks:

* Competitive salaries and equity grants
* Unlimited time off to promote a healthy work\-life balance
* H/D/V coverage along with 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
* Frequent team celebrations and recreation events
* Home internet \& phone stipend

Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects

Via Collective is hiring a part\-time, hybrid Project Coordinator in NYC ($20–$30/hr) to support Project Directors and Managers in tracking schedules, budgets, communication, and resource planning for signage and wayfinding projects. The role requires 2–4 years of coordination experience, strong organizational skills, and proficiency in tools like Asana and Adobe Creative Suite.


### **Description**


At Via Collective, we’re passionate about crafting experiences that guide and connect people to their environments. The Project Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the successful delivery of signage and wayfinding projects by coordinating project information, schedules, resources, budgets, and communications across multidisciplinary teams.


The Project Coordinator is a project support and coordination role working under the direction of the Project Director and/or Project Manager. The position is responsible for organizing information, tracking project activities, coordinating communication and resources, and identifying items that require the attention or decision of the Project Director/Manager. Final decision\-making for project direction, client decisions, scope, contracts, and project approvals remains with the Project Director/Manager.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day project activities, ensuring information flows efficiently between the Project Director/Manager, clients, consultants, and the internal design team.
* Maintain strong working relationships through responsive, supportive, and professional client communication
* Under the direction of the Project Director/Manager:
	+ Coordinate communications with clients, subconsultants, and vendors under the direction of the Project Director/Manager, ensuring questions, information, and follow\-up items are routed appropriately.
	+ Maintain and monitor project schedules, milestones, and action items
	+ Build, update, and maintain projects in Asana
	+ Coordinate project meetings by scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, documenting meeting notes, tracking follow\-up actions, and following up as necessary
	+ Track project budgets and progress, escalating potential risks or schedule impacts to the Project Director/Manager.
	+ Maintain and update staff resource planning to be able to see all projects and staffing resources simultaneously every week
	+ Support the design team in preparing project deliverables, transmittals, updating client comment logs, and maintaining and resolving RFI logs.
	+ Track project decisions, outstanding issues, and scope changes throughout the project lifecycle.
	+ Prepare draft scope change documentation and added scope requests (ASRs) for review and approval by Project Director/Manager.
	+ Support improvements to project workflows, documentation, and coordination processes.
	+ Support Project Managers on larger, more complex projects as assigned.
* Follow company policies and procedures, including folder and file organization, naming, and structure.
* Support the firm’s QA/QC process by reviewing project materials for completeness, accuracy, formatting, and adherence to established project standards before client distribution.
* Attend weekly internal design team coordination meetings to report on and coordinate your projects, weekly resource planning meetings to coordinate designer assignments, and external project meetings as needed.

* Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills.
* High level attention to detail and commitment to producing high\-quality work.
* Superb verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong customer service mindset and ability to build positive relationships with clients and project teams.
* Self\-motivated, resourceful, collaborative, and proactive in solving problems.
* Strong professional judgment, presentation skills, and the ability to manage confidential information appropriately.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, MS Office, Google Suite Applications, Asana, and Monograph.
* This is a part\-time hybrid position with flexible in\-office time on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Candidates must have easy access to New York City and the surrounding area, as local travel for meetings or site visits will not be reimbursed unless directed by the contract.

### **Required Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in design, business management, communications, or related discipline
* 2\-4 years of experience in coordination or project management roles.
* Wayfinding, architecture, engineering, or interior design firm experience is preferred but not required.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience coordinating design and construction documentation projects.
* Familiarity with resource planning, project financial tracking, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Interest in environmental graphic design, signage, and wayfinding systems.

### **What We Value**

* A commitment to high\-quality design and execution.
* A growth mindset, always seeking new insights and improvements.
* A positive and collaborative attitude, fostering a supportive team environment.
* Alignment with our firm’s vision and values, contributing to the long\-term success of both our projects and our team.

### **Why Join Us**


This is a unique opportunity to contribute to impactful design projects. At Via Collective, we value a positive, collaborative environment where everyone’s input is respected, and growth is encouraged. If you’re looking for a role where you can develop your project coordination skills, take ownership of your work, and contribute to a collaborative team, we’d love to hear from you.

Qualifications:

* **Experience with data collection, entry, reporting and quality assurance**

jobs.title: Hospital-Based Violence Intervention Program (HVIP) - Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The HVIP Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating daily program operations across University Hospital (UH) and Newark Beth Israel Medical Center (NBI). The position coordinates Community Health Workers (CHWs), manages program data and reporting, monitors operational activities, and maintains communication with hospital personnel, NCST leadership, and community partners.

The coordinator ensures consistent program implementation, accurate documentation, timely reporting, effective communication, and follow\-through across both hospital sites. This position works under the direction of the Director of HVIP and is accountable for maintaining organized, efficient, and responsive program operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1\. Multi\-Site Program Coordination

* Coordinate daily HVIP operations across University Hospital and Newark Beth Israel.
* Monitor program activities, referrals, participant follow\-ups, and outstanding operational tasks at both sites.
* Maintain consistent workflows, documentation procedures, and program standards across hospital locations.
* Coordinate hospital meetings, on\-site activities, and communication with designated hospital contacts.
* Identify operational barriers, service gaps, and site\-specific needs and communicate them to NCST leadership.
* Maintain trackers for assignments, deadlines, meetings, and unresolved concerns. ● Provide regular updates on program activities, challenges, and outcomes across both locations.

2\. Community Health Worker Coordination

* Provide day\-to\-day operational coordination and support to CHWs assigned to both hospital sites.
* Conduct weekly check\-ins to review caseloads, participant needs, service plans, documentation, and follow\-up responsibilities.
* Monitor completion of assigned tasks and communicate outstanding responsibilities to CHWs.
* Reinforce NCST policies, hospital protocols, documentation standards, and professional expectations.
* Support CHWs in coordinating participant services and addressing barriers to care.
* Identify recurring workflow, communication, or performance concerns and escalate matters requiring supervisory intervention to NCST leadership.
* Ensure CHWs receive timely updates regarding program procedures, hospital expectations, and operational changes.

3\. Data Management and Reporting

* Manage HVIP data collection, data entry, data quality assurance, and reporting across both hospital sites.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely participant and program records in designated systems.
* Monitor documentation and data entry for missing information, inconsistencies, and overdue records.
* Develop and maintain data trackers, caseload reports, service utilization reports, and program dashboards as needed.
* Track participant encounters, referrals, service connections, follow\-up activities, and program outcomes.
* Prepare weekly reports distinguishing UH and NBI activity while providing combined program totals.
* Compile reports for NCST leadership, hospital partners, and funders as assigned.
* Identify trends, reporting discrepancies, and service gaps and communicate findings to NCST leadership.
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with applicable data security and recordkeeping requirements.

4\. Participant Services and Care Coordination

* Support CHWs in coordinating participant access to healthcare, behavioral health, housing, transportation, employment, and community resources.
* Monitor referrals, service plans, and follow\-up activities to support continuity of care.
* Help identify barriers to participant engagement and coordinate appropriate referrals and internal support.
* Support communication between participants, CHWs, hospital personnel, and community providers while maintaining confidentiality and participant choice.
* Escalate participant\-related concerns requiring clinical, supervisory, or executive decisions to the appropriate personnel.

5\. Hospital and Community Partner Communication

* Maintain professional working relationships with University Hospital, Newark Beth Israel, NCST personnel, and community partners.
* Attend assigned hospital and partner meetings.
* Communicate program updates, operational needs, and action items to relevant stakeholders.
* Follow established communication protocols and supervisory structures when addressing hospital or partner concerns.
* Provide written follow\-up on significant meetings and operational discussions, including decisions, assigned responsibilities, and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate communication between hospital sites when operational issues affect both locations.
* Promptly communicate concerns involving participant services, CHW assignments, hospital operations, or interagency coordination to the appropriate NCST supervisor.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities across two hospital sites.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data management, reporting, documentation, and quality assurance skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, databases, and related reporting tools.
* Ability to follow established procedures, supervisory direction, and communication protocols.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with hospital staff, CHWs, community partners, and participants.
* Knowledge of healthcare coordination, community resources, and barriers to care.
* Demonstrated professionalism, accountability, sound judgment, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Understanding of trauma\-informed, survivor\-centered, and culturally responsive services.

Pay: Up to $73,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Required)

Experience:

* Community Health: 3 years (Preferred)
* Program Coordination : 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Residence Program Specialist II - Thurs-Mon, 3pm-11pm
jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**


It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist II will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well\-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD\-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in\-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $19\.62/hour \+ Industry\-Leading Benefits for all full\-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Collegiate
jobs.description:
**Position:** Program Coordinator, Collegiate Programs

**Department:** Pre\-College and Collegiate Division (PCD)  

**Location:** New York  

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager, Collegiate Programs

**Classification:** Permanent, Full Time  

**Start Date:** Immediate

**Hours**: Approximately 40 hours per week during business hours 9am – 5pm, Monday – Friday; some


evening and weekend work required; additional hours may be pre\-approved by the Senior Program Manager during periods of high delivery demands.  

**Salary:** $24 / hr.

**Position Context**


Edconic is a successful group of education businesses, including Sotheby’s Institute of Art, The School of The New York Times, Manchester City Sports Business School, and Vogue College of Fashion. Its mission is to build compelling education programs in partnership with the world’s best brands. The Pre\-College and Collegiate Division (PCD) supports its expansion and plans for growth by working across schools on the development and delivery of non\-MA programs.


 The Program Coordinator, Collegiate Programs role is integral to the delivery of Collegiate Program within Sotheby’s Institute of Art – New York, Vogue College of Fashion – New York, and School of the New York Times. Sotheby’s Institute of Art, founded by Sotheby’s Auction House in 1969, has pioneered the education of arts professionals and offers a wide range of Masters’ degrees, semester courses, and professional programs. Since 2004, Vogue College of Fashion has been providing students with the knowledge, networks and practical experience to become future leaders in the fashion industry and offers a range of degree and non\-degree programs. School of The New York Times, established in partnership with The New York Times in 2016, provides students with an immersive educational experience rooted in journalism, media, and storytelling. Drawing on the expertise and resources of The New York Times, the School offers a range of programs designed to develop practical skills, critical thinking, and industry knowledge for aspiring journalists, writers, and media professionals. Collegiate (undergraduate) academic courses are validated by the University of Montana.

 **Role Purpose**  

 The Program Coordinator plays an essential role in the preparation and successful delivery of Collegiate Programs. Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, this role supports the planning, developing, and execution of program delivery and contributing to the overall operations of Collegiate, ensuring a well\-organized program.


The role includes responsibilities such as coordinating co\-curricular activities, onboarding faculty and guest speakers, handling class materials, overseeing logistics, and facilitating communication between staff, faculty, guest speakers and students. The Program Coordinator also supports student needs and assists with general operational tasks throughout the program.


Serving as a primary point of contact for students and course leaders, the Program Coordinator will liaise with internal departments including facilities and IT. They will also work closely with colleagues to provide consistent, high\-quality administrative support to both students and staff.


This is a full\-time position that requires **on\-site support** during program delivery, or as directed by the Senior Program Manager. The role will include some evening and weekend hours, as well as additional duties as required with reasonable notice.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the planning and delivery of Collegiate programs, ensuring a high\-quality and well\-organized experience for students, faculty, and partners. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Program Delivery \& Operations:**  

 Support the coordination and execution of all on\-the\-ground program operations, including scheduling, catering, transportation, classroom logistics, and site visits. Ensure all activities run smoothly and efficiently.
* **Site Visits \& Events Coordination:**  

Organize, book, and track logistics for site visits, co\-curricular activities, and student events. Serve as a chaperone when needed.
* **Classroom \& Materials Management:**  

 Prepare and distribute class materials, supplies, and resources, ensuring all program\-related materials are delivered accurately and on time.
* **Guest Speaker \& Faculty Support:**
	+ Coordinate guest speaker logistics, including onboarding documentation, contracts, payments, scheduling, and technical setup (e.g., Zoom).
	+ Provide ongoing support to faculty and assist with faculty\-related activities and events. Meet with faculty prior to the program to review course content, identify teaching support needs, and confirm classroom requirements.
* **Communication \& Stakeholder Coordination:**  

 Act as a key point of contact for students, faculty, and course leaders. Manage program communications, including monitoring shared inboxes, and facilitating coordination with internal departments (Facilities and IT) and external vendors.
* **Student Support \& Welfare:**  

 Provide day\-to\-day support to students, responding to inquiries and addressing concerns. Monitor student wellbeing and escalate issues as appropriate to senior staff. Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment.
* **Administrative \& Financial Support:**  

 Maintain accurate records, track budgets, process invoices, and support financial reporting. Assist with purchasing tickets, supplies, and other program\-related items.
* **Systems \& Data Management:**  

 Maintain student\-facing platforms (e.g., Canvas) with up\-to\-date schedules, course materials, and resources. Track and manage program data using internal systems.
* **Program Activities \& Engagement:**  

 Support in organizing and delivering virtual and in\-person pre\-program orientations, in\-person orientation sessions, ongoing student engagement

This is a hands\-on, multifaceted role requiring a strong understanding of the luxury fashion industry, garment construction, textiles, and the intricacies of operating a boutique couture house. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who can balance production management, studio operations, client relations, social media, and creative development while taking the lead in managing a team of interns. The position requires someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes initiative, and is comfortable managing multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced setting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Coordination:** Coordinate production from initial development through completion, working closely with the designer and production team to establish timelines, maintain quality standards, and ensure deadlines are met.
* **Creative \& Design Development:** Assist with embroidery and beading layout development in collaboration with the designer and communicating with vendors to ensure projects are completed accurately and in a timely manner.
* **Production Costing \& Order Management:** Maintain sewing hours, production records, and detailed costing sheets. Prepare, process, and manage sales orders and purchase orders.

Oversee the atelier's social media presence, including content planning, creation, scheduling, and publishing.
* **Internship Management \& Leadership:** Recruit, organize, and lead a team of interns, overseeing their schedules, assigning responsibilities, coordinating projects, and providing guidance and supervision.
* **Studio \& Operations Management:** Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the atelier, maintaining an organized, efficient, and productive studio environment. Manage administrative functions, digital files, physical records, and general office organization. Provide hands\-on support across all departments, adapting to the evolving needs of the studio and contributing to its overall success.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset and the flexibility to adapt in a fast\-paced, creative environment.

* Stay informed about school purchasing cycles and proactively contact customers ahead of upcoming school years, events, graduations, athletic seasons, and other important deadlines.
* Provide excellent customer service before, during, and after each sale to encourage repeat business and referrals.

Requirements

* Previous experience in outside sales, business development, account management, or customer service is preferred.
* Experience working with schools, uniforms, apparel, promotional products, or educational organizations is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the confidence to speak with school administrators and other decision\-makers.
* Excellent relationship\-building and customer service skills.
* Strong negotiation and sales\-closing abilities.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable prospecting for new customers and developing new accounts.
* Ability to manage multiple leads, customers, appointments, and follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Comfortable using CRM software and other computer\-based sales and communication tools.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal team members.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel locally to schools, meetings, and events as needed.
* Bilingual or multilingual abilities are a plus.

Join Our Team

You will have the opportunity to develop new accounts, build lasting customer relationships, and help schools find uniform and apparel solutions that meet the needs of their students, staff, and communities.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

  


**Position Summary:**

  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Coordinator.

  

  

Responsible for providing moderate to advanced range of coordination of Research studies conducted at the Medical Center, assists with the recruitment, enrollment, grant submissions, research data collection and study coordination activities. Performs intra\-operative monitoring and serves as liaison with internal and external funding agencies. Ensures the accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPAA, and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator, Research Team and sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and Principal Investigator in support of the clinical trials if applicable. Establishes liaisons with relevant parties at the Medical Center that may include: Research Nurses, Research Pharmacists, Program Managers, Medical Technicians, Clinical Information Systems and regulatory Services. Might assist in the initiation and management of research studies. Works independently, under general direction.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**

  


* Grants \-Prepares and submit grant applications and other grants related an activity such as developing grants applications/proposals and fund raising activities if applicable. Collects and organizes required paperwork for submission if applicable. Follow up and coordinates resolution of all issues progress. Reports to the sponsors to fund medical research in the division.
* Human Subjects' Research \- As applicable, oversee the submission of necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research (e.g., ensures the update and submission of necessary documents and/or forms to appropriate destination). Might prepare, audit and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials, and provides other information in timely manner, as necessary.
* Study Regulations \- Aware of study regulatory status and keep an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Assists with the informed consent process and ensure that the patient/subject fully understands what is required of them throughout the study. Follows through regularly with the patient/subjects reminding them of visits and compliance. May monitor any outward effects or issues regarding patient/subject safety and report this to the Principal Investigator, Physician and Research Nurse.
* Data Management \- Responsible for collecting and auditing patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Audits and manages data from and into the database. Prepares forms and reports, compiles and analyses data, statistics, and other materials for reports. Conducts study visits, obtains and documents information within the time frame specified.
* Budget \- Develops a preliminary draft budget and submit to the Director/Principal Investigator. Reviews sponsor\-proposed budget for adequate coverage and recommend changes as appropriate. Assists in the preparation of funding reports to funding agencies and helps identify new potential sponsors/agents for trials and researches. Monitor budget throughout trial.
* Decision Making and Problems Solving Combines and evaluates information and data to make decisions about relative importance of information and choosing the best solution to solve problems. Resolves complex situations and refers non solved issues and questions with recommendation to supervisor.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.
* Recruitment \- Screens potential patients/subjects for eligibility to the study. This may include gathering information from the medical record, physician referral, advertisement and directly scheduling a visit to evaluate the patient/subject. Reviews all the elements of the screening process with the Principal Investigator that being: inclusion/exclusion criteria, completed informed consent, documentation of the event and the patient/subject willingness to participate in the study.
* Clinical Competency \- competency in performing EKG, phlebotomy technique, centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Other trainings and competencies may be included as required.
* Continuous Learning \- Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development (training programs are provided through the SOM). Promotes own professional growth and development in research role and maintains current expertise in area of practice. Maintains annual requirement of 10 CEUs in continuing research
