**About Enlace Chicago**: Enlace Chicago convenes, organizes, and strengthens the capacity of stakeholders across Little Village to confront systemic inequities and expand access to economic and social opportunity. For more than 35 years, Enlace has served as a trusted community anchor—championing opportunity, improving lives, and building partnerships that drive lasting change.


Through our work, we advance community health, protect human rights, empower futures, promote safety, and foster resilience for families throughout Little Village. Our core departments—Education, Community Safety, Mental Health, Community Health, and Immigration \& Advocacy—deliver critical, culturally responsive services that uplift and support the strength and dignity of our community

**Position Overview:**

The **Part\-Time Parent Mentor Coordinator (PMC)** is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the implementation of the Parent Mentor Program (PMP) at their assigned school. Serving as the primary liaison between Enlace Chicago and the school community, the PMC supervises, coaches, and supports Parent Mentors to ensure successful classroom engagement and program implementation.


The PMC works closely with school administrators, teachers, families, and Enlace Chicago staff to foster strong school\-family partnerships and cultivate parent leadership. In collaboration with Enlace organizers and community partners, the PMC recruits, engages, and develops parent leaders while promoting meaningful family participation in school and community initiatives. Although employed by Enlace Chicago, the PMC is based at their assigned school and serves as an integral member of the school community.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Program Implementation \& Coordination:**

Recruit, coordinate, and implement the Parent Mentor Program at the assigned school, ensuring high\-quality program delivery in partnership with school staff, PEI, and Enlace Chicago.

* **Parent Mentor Supervision \& Leadership Development:**

Supervise, coach, train, and develop Parent Mentors through regular observations, workshops, leadership development, and ongoing support.

* **Compliance \& Administrative Management:**

Ensure program compliance by maintaining accurate documentation, submitting reports and stipend paperwork on time, and adhering to Enlace Chicago, PEI, and school district policies.

* **Community Engagement \& Collaboration**


Build strong relationships with families, school staff, and community partners while promoting parent leadership, organizing community engagement opportunities, and collaborating across Enlace Chicago teams.

**Core Competencies:**

* **Program Management \& Accountability:** Effectively coordinates program implementation, manages multiple priorities, ensures compliance, and meets reporting deadlines.
* **Community Engagement \& Relationship Building:** Builds strong partnerships with families, school staff, and community stakeholders while fostering meaningful parent engagement.
* **Communication \& Collaboration:** Demonstrates strong bilingual communication, facilitation, and teamwork skills to effectively engage diverse audiences and work across departments.

**Compensation:** The salary range for this position annually is 25/hour. Salary is commensurate with experience.

**Benefits:**

* *Paid time off.* Enlace complies with the Illinois***Paid Leave***for All Workers Act (PLAWA). Eligible non\-exempt employees accrue **1 hour of Paid Leave for every 40 hours worked**, up to **40 hours per year**. Paid Leave may be used for any reason and unused accrued leave is paid out upon separation, as required by law.
* ***Paid Sick Leave*** Eligible employees accrue **1 hour of Paid** **Sick** **Leave for every 40 hours worked**, up to **40 hours per year**. Paid Sick Leave may be used for qualifying personal or family medical needs in accordance with Enlace's Sick Leave Policy and applicable law.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion:**


At Enlace Chicago, we are deeply committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where all voices are heard and valued. We believe that diverse perspectives are essential to addressing the complex social challenges we seek to solve, and we strive to create a culture that promotes belonging, respect, and opportunity for all. EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job\-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. jobs.description:
**Summary**



The CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator will keep Topstep's CRM instance clean, organized, and running smoothly. This role owns the day\-to\-day operational health of the CRM: database hygiene, subscription management, folder and file organization, campaign setup and tracking, and QA, and will provide hands\-on execution support for lifecycle and evergreen email programs.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and comfortable owning recurring, process\-driven work. You're curious about marketing technology and enjoy exploring and standing up new tools, and you take pride in a well\-maintained system that others can rely on. You will work closely with the Sr. Lifecycle \& CRM Marketing Lead and collaborate with Creative and QA partners to keep lifecycle communications running without a hitch


**Key Responsibilities**


**CRM Platform \& Database Management**


* Keep contact lists clean and healthy: merge duplicate records, process unsubscribes/unbounce requests, and audit subscription and preference center settings to ensure they work as intended.
* Maintain the folder structures and naming conventions for content, creative, and file assets within HubSpot so teams can find what they need.
* Explore and evaluate new HubSpot tools and features as they roll out (e.g., AI features, surveys, HubDB, ASO) and lead hands\-on setup and configuration.
* Serve as the go\-to owner for day\-to\-day CRM hygiene and platform upkeep.


**Campaign \& Lifecycle Execution Support**


* Support lifecycle and evergreen email programs by monitoring for breaks or errors, tracking send volume, and flagging opportunities for improvement.
* Set up and configure campaigns in the CRM to ensure proper tracking and attribution of email performance.
* Partner with QA teams to run pre\-send testing (rendering, links, personalization tokens, deliverability) across lifecycle and campaign emails.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with Engineering, Marketing Operations and Analytics teams.
* Coordinate with Creative and Brand partners on asset intake, organization, and file handoffs.
* Support QA and testing partners to ensure every send meets quality standards before launch.


**Required Qualifications and Key Competencies**


* 3\+ years of experience in email marketing operations, CRM administration, or marketing operations.
* Highly detail\-oriented and organized, with a strong sense of ownership over recurring, process\-driven work.
* Experience with database hygiene practices such as deduplication, list segmentation, and subscription/preference management.
* Familiarity with QA and testing processes for email campaigns.
* Basic email building and scheduling experience.
* Experience in Google slides for process document creation.
* Must have basic HTML knowledge (CSS and Handlebar (Or equivalent) is a plus).
* Curiosity and comfort exploring and adopting new marketing technology and tools.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with Creative, QA, and Marketing partners.


**Preferred Qualifications and Key Competencies**


* Hands\-on HubSpot experience.


**Company Culture \& Perks**

* Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Employee referrals are bonused. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.

**Who We Are**  

Hi! We’re Thinkingbox, the brief to built agency. Creating innovative digital, experiential, social, and content, we partner with leading brands across industries like sports, gaming, entertainment, and technology. We believe the hands that carefully craft the work should belong to the minds that dreamed it. So while others pass the buck, we’re already building. Because our thinkers are also the makers. Culture is at the heart of who we are, and our offices are hubs of natural collaboration. From hanging out with our office dogs to enjoying Thursday happy hours, we keep our work environment vibrant, welcoming, and fun. Each year, we also encourage our people to spend a month exploring the world, whether that means working from another office or even from the beaches of Mexico, to expand their perspectives and bring fresh inspiration back to the team.


**The Opportunity**  

As a Production Coordinator, you will support the planning and execution of integrated projects across experiential, content, social, and digital. You will work closely with Producers, Project Managers, Creative teams, and external partners to help keep projects running smoothly from kickoff through delivery.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced agency environment, enjoys problem solving, and is eager to grow their production career across multiple disciplines.



### **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Producers and Project Managers on experiential, content, strategy, social, and digital projects
* Assist with project scheduling, timelines, and production calendars
* Help coordinate internal teams, freelancers, vendors, and external partners
* Track project deliverables, assets, and approvals
* Prepare call sheets, production documents, and status updates
* Assist with budgets, purchase orders, invoices, and expense tracking
* Help ensure projects stay on scope, schedule, and budget
* Support on set or on site production as needed
* Maintain clear and consistent communication across teams

### **What You'll Bring**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in production coordination, project coordination, or a related role, ideally within an agency or production environment
* Experience or strong interest in experiential, content, social, and digital production
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills
* Strong attention to detail and follow through
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once in a fast paced environment
* Comfortable working with tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, and project management platforms
* A collaborative, proactive, and solutions oriented mindset

### **Bonus Points!**

* Experience supporting live events, activations, or on site productions
* Experience in the hospitality/service industry
* On set experience
* Familiarity with content production workflows including video, photography, and social
* Basic understanding of budgets and production finance
* Experience working with external vendors and freelancers

### **Additional Info**

* Monday \- Thursday in office (Fridays are remote optional)
* Flexible time off, including paid vacation and sick days
* Consistent culture and team\-building events
* Employee recognition and incentive programs
* Seasonal celebrations and gatherings throughout the year
* Office lunches
* Branded company swag
* Access to industry events, learning opportunities, and non\-profit outreaches
* Dog\-friendly offices
* Unlimited coffee, drinks, and snacks
* Flex work and travel options
* Comprehensive extended health benefits
* 401k matching

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as internal equity, candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role. If your compensation expectations fall outside of this range, we still welcome your application.

At Thinkingbox, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity is our creative strength – it's the range of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds that fuels our best ideas and most innovative solutions. We welcome and encourage applicants of all races, ethnicities, genders, identities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, and backgrounds to apply. Your voice matters here.

jobs.title: Named Regional Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Named Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting new role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the Mid\-Market segment. The RAM is a field sales position responsible for a specific set of Mid\-Market accounts while also having shared responsibility for all Mid\-Market business within their territory. The ideal candidate will have previous field sales experience in the B2B technology space. The RAM will create and execute an account plan from prospecting to building and maintaining a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to begin your career. Once completed, you will be assigned an individual territory and quota and given ongoing enablement and coaching to achieve the highest levels of success. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall career path at Fortinet.  



**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory
* Meet or exceed the required number of face\-to\-face meetings each month with customers and partners in territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.
* Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts and recognition.
* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations and quotes in Salesforce.com)
* Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner
* Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility, and provide necessary presales support for prospects \& customers.
* Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the Mid\-Market segment.
* Follow up on inbound, web and corporate event leads
* Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
* Lead customer presentation and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING)
* Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported
* Act as a liaison between partner, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members
* Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth or our business
Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values  
* 

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Coachable and flexible
* 1\+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space
* Working knowledge of the businesses and partners in the local territory
* Ability to run productive customer\-facing and partner\-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow up
* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally
* Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota
* Self\-driven and able to manage a diverse, high volume workload
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment
* Be computer savvy
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward\-thinking manner
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction
* Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values
The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Public/private cloud experience is a plus
* Experience with multi\-tier distribution a plus.
* Experience in networking, security and/or public/private cloud a plus

jobs.title: Surety Account Manager III
jobs.description:
Posting Description: **Surety Account Manager III**

  

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high\-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients!

  

This hybrid position requires working 3 days a week from an Aon office.

 **Aon is in the business of better decisions**


At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

  

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

 **What the day will look like**


Provides analytical and operational services for a portfolio of surety bond clients, with an emphasis on accuracy, client interaction, underwriting pricing rigor \& negotiation, and execution quality. Partners closely with clients to facilitate timely issuance of surety obligations. Reports to the regional Surety Operations leader. (Director or Team Lead).

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment across complex or strategically significant accounts and in dealing with markets.
* Takes primary accountability for handling selected key accounts, including coordination of large bond programs and sophisticated underwriting submissions.
* Possesses strong, in\-depth knowledge of surety bonds, including contract and commercial surety, indemnity structures, and market dynamics.
* Serves as a technical lead within the team; assists in training, mentoring, and developing internal team, and contributes to improvement in execution initiatives.
* Collaborates daily with carriers on complex needs. Prepares and processes a broad range of surety instruments, including but not limited to bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds, ensuring alignment with underwriting parameters and client requirements.
* Collaborates daily with clients on complex needs. Completes Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other client required obligations per State requirements. Determines appropriate documentation to finalize issuance, i.e. power\-of\-attorney, resident license, etc. with attention to contractual, legal, and financial implications.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications, coordinating with and advising clients to obtain complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review – including any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and facilitates data integrity and enabling proactive management of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to build and maintain accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). It also confirms and manages client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to avoid E\&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety guidance and support to non\-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work\-in\-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority; assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests that exceed standard limits or fall outside delegated authority.

 **How this opportunity is different**


Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in operational improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

 **Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Is able to effectively interpret a wide range of technical instructions and documentation involving abstract and concrete variables, including financial analyses, contractual provisions, and underwriting guidelines.
* Possesses experience or formal education in Risk Management, Insurance, and/or Surety, and applies this background to enhance client and market outcomes.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, time\-management, and multi\-tasking skills, consistently managing high\-volume and complex workloads.
* Maintains Notary Public designation.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and is regarded as a trusted signatory.
* Maintains appropriate Producer license
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook, and utilizes these systems to manage data, analyze bond portfolios, and support decision\-making.

  

Education and licensing requirements: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Property and Casualty license.

**Social Media \& Content Marketing Manager**

Preferred Location: Chicago, IL area/ Hybrid  
Reports to: SVP, Brand \& Community Impact  
Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000

**About Planet Harvest**

Planet Harvest is a mission\-driven company working to maximize the value of the whole harvest. We partner with growers, food companies, corporations, and community organizations to create innovative solutions that reduce food waste, strengthen the food system and expand access to fresh food. Our work spans fresh food sourcing, whole harvest innovation, corporate partnerships, and community impact programs across the country.

**The Opportunity**

Planet Harvest is seeking a Social Media \& Content Marketing Manager to lead the day\-to\-day development and execution of our social media and content strategy.

This is a hands\-on role for a strong storyteller and content creator who can turn the work happening across Planet Harvest, from farms and food innovation to corporate partnerships and community impact, into compelling content that builds awareness, engagement and brand visibility. The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with a willingness to execute. This person will own the content calendar, manage Planet Harvest's social channels, create and capture content, support partner amplification, and help build a consistent and differentiated Planet Harvest brand presence.

This role reports to the SVP, Brand \& Community Impact and will work closely across the organization and with external partners.

**What You’ll Do**

Own Social Media \& Content

* Develop and manage Planet Harvest's social media and content strategy, with an initial focus on LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Own the editorial calendar, including planning, creating, scheduling and publishing content.
* Write compelling social copy and develop content across video, photography, graphics and other formats.
* Manage day\-to\-day community engagement and identify opportunities to grow Planet Harvest's audience and visibility.
* Stay current on social trends, platform changes and emerging content formats.

Bring the Planet Harvest Story to Life

* Identify and develop stories across Planet Harvest's work in agriculture, food, innovation, partnerships and community impact.
* Interview farmers, partners, employees and community organizations to uncover authentic stories and perspectives.
* Translate complex or behind\-the\-scenes work into accessible, engaging content.
* Develop stories that demonstrate Planet Harvest's impact and reinforce the company's broader brand positioning.
* Build and maintain a strong library of photo, video and storytelling assets.

Capture Content in the Field

* Develop content plans for key Planet Harvest events, farm visits, food distributions and partner activations.
* Attend select activations and events to personally capture photo, video and social content.
* Create timely, engaging content from the field while identifying opportunities for longer\-form and evergreen storytelling.

Support Marketing \& Partnerships

* Develop content that supports brand awareness, customer acquisition and strategic partnerships.
* Create social and communications toolkits that make it easy for corporate and community partners to amplify Planet Harvest initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for collaborative content, partner posts and executive amplification.
* Work closely with internal teams to ensure content supports company priorities and key initiatives.

Measure \& Optimize

* Track social media and content performance and establish regular reporting.
* Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement and content performance.
* Use data and insights to continuously improve content strategy and execution.
* Identify which stories, channels and formats are most effective in building awareness and engagement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4–7 years of experience in social media, content marketing, brand marketing, communications or a related field.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated experience managing brand social media channels, particularly LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Experience creating short\-form video, photography and visual social content.
* Ability to personally take content from idea through execution—from identifying the story and capturing assets to writing, publishing and measuring performance.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of what makes content engaging and shareable.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects, partners and deadlines.
* Self\-starter who can independently identify opportunities and move work forward.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Collaborative and comfortable working with a range of stakeholders, from farmers and nonprofit partners to corporate executives.
* Willingness to travel periodically for events, activations, farm visits and content capture.

**Nice to Have**

Experience in food, agriculture, sustainability, health and wellness, corporate social impact or purpose\-driven brands is a plus, as is experience with executive thought leadership, partner collaborations, PR, graphic design, photography or video editing.

**Who You Are**

You are a storyteller and a doer. You see the story before someone has to ask you to tell it. You are as comfortable developing a content strategy as you are capturing an iPhone video at an event, writing the caption and getting it published.

You are curious, creative and highly organized. You know how to take a big idea and turn it into content people actually want to engage with. You enjoy working across teams and with external partners, but you don't need a large team or agency to make things happen.

Most importantly, you are excited by the opportunity to help build the voice and visibility of a growing company working at the intersection of food, agriculture, innovation and community impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

### **Ready to launch your career with Global Payments?**

  

As a Business Development Representative and become part of a high\-energy sales team helping businesses transform the way they manage payments. If you're driven, curious, and excited about FinTech, SaaS, and sales, this is your opportunity to build a successful career with a global leader in payments technology**.**

### **What you'll own**

* Create a great first impression with prospective customers while building a pipeline of qualified sales opportunities for your Account Executive partners.
* Respond to inbound inquiries through phone and email while delivering an exceptional customer experience.
* Prospect outbound within your assigned territory using SalesLoft, LinkedIn, phone outreach, and industry events.
* Research prospective companies to ensure every interaction is personalized, relevant, and high quality.
* Maintain accurate sales activity, lead, and opportunity information within Salesforce.
* Achieve or exceed monthly goals for meetings set and qualified opportunities generated.
* Develop strong business acumen to engage prospects in meaningful business conversations.
* Contribute to a collaborative, energetic, and team\-oriented sales culture.

### **What you'll bring**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong active listening skills and the ability to uncover customer needs and align them to solutions.
* Strong organization, time management, and prioritization skills.
* Self\-motivation, resilience, and a results\-oriented mindset.
* Passion for technology, FinTech, SaaS, and developing a career in sales.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* High School Diploma or GED.
* Typically 2\+ years of relevant professional experience.

### **It's a bonus if you have**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* B2B sales, cold calling, prospecting, or lead generation experience.
* Previous success in a customer\-facing, sales, internship, or business development role.
* Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Demonstrated perseverance, learning agility, and a strong desire to succeed.
* Experience in technology, software, SaaS, or FinTech environments.

### **About the team**


Our Business Development Team serves as the first point of contact for many prospective customers and plays a critical role in driving new business growth. Through a mix of inbound lead management and strategic outbound prospecting, the team uncovers opportunities, builds relationships, and partners closely with Account Executives to help organizations discover the value of MineralTree's solutions. This role offers hands\-on training, sales mentorship, and a proven pathway into a long\-term sales career.

### **What makes a Globalpayer?**


Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner, and win as one team. We're curious, accountable, and always looking for better ways to create value for our customers. We empower one another to make decisions, grow professionally, and celebrate success together. If you're ready to start or accelerate your sales career while making an impact at a global leader in payments technology, we'd love to hear from you.


Global Payments is dedicated to offering individuals rewarding career opportunities and competitive compensation. For this full\-time position, the good faith estimated annual salary range upon hire is $39,700\.0\-$59,050\.00\. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on the role’s responsibilities, level, and geographic location. The actual starting salary will be determined by a candidate’s experience, job\-related skills, and relevant education or training. Please note that changes in work location may impact the final offered salary. We encourage you to consult with your recruiter to confirm the budget for your location and to better understand the applicable pay scale. **EEOC Statement**

  

Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here.

  

If you are made a conditional offer of employment and will be working in the United States, you will be required to undergo a drug test. In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies and requirements needed to successfully perform the position. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for individuals with qualified disabilities both during the hiring process, as well as to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, if hired.

jobs.title: In-Home Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**IN\-HOME SALES CONSULTANT**

**Kitchen Revive \| Chicago Market**

**LEADS PROVIDED \| $100K\+ FIRST\-YEAR EARNING POTENTIAL**

**Join One of the Fastest\-Growing Kitchen Companies in Chicago**

Kitchen Revive is growing throughout the Chicago market, and we’re looking for motivated, competitive people who want an opportunity to build a successful career in sales.

This is an **in\-home sales position with company\-provided leads**.

No cold calling.No door\-to\-door prospecting.No building your own lead list.

We provide the opportunities, training, and support. You meet with homeowners, help them design the right kitchen solution, and guide them through the buying process.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Kitchen Revive helps homeowners transform outdated kitchens through cabinet refacing, countertops, and other kitchen upgrades — providing a beautiful new look without the expense and disruption of a complete kitchen remodel.

You’ll meet with homeowners who have already expressed interest in improving their kitchen.

During the appointment, you’ll:

* Build rapport and understand the homeowner’s goals **Evaluate their existing kitchen** Help select cabinet styles, colors, countertops, and upgrades **Present Kitchen Revive products and pricing** Help the homeowner confidently make a decision **Complete the sale when Kitchen Revive is the right fit**

**EARNING POTENTIAL**

This is a performance\-based sales opportunity with **$100,000\+ first\-year earning potential for successful representatives.**

Your income is connected to your results.

We provide:

* Company\-generated leads **Professional sales training** Product and design training **A structured sales process** Ongoing coaching and development **Marketing support** A growing Chicago territory

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We’re looking for people who are:

* Competitive and goal\-oriented
* Highly coachable
* Confident communicating face\-to\-face
* Personable and professional
* Motivated by achievement and income
* Comfortable asking for the sale
* Accountable for their results
* Resilient and positive
* Interested in continuous improvement
* Excited about joining a growing company

Sales experience is a plus, but it isn’t the only thing we consider.

People with backgrounds in sales, athletics, hospitality, fitness, automotive, recruiting, wireless, home improvement, and other performance\-driven environments can be a great fit.

**OUR CULTURE**

Kitchen Revive is building a sales culture centered around **training, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.**

We believe great salespeople aren’t simply hired — they’re developed.

You’ll receive coaching, understand your numbers, learn from each appointment, and continually work on improving your skills.

We want people who enjoy being part of a team while still being motivated by their individual performance.

**GROW WITH KITCHEN REVIVE**

Kitchen Revive is building one of the fastest\-growing kitchen remodeling operations in the Chicago market.

As the company continues to expand, we expect new opportunities to develop in:

* Sales **Training** Team leadership **Sales management** Market leadership

We want our future leaders to come from the people who help us grow today.

**YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF…**

You enjoy competition.

You like working toward measurable goals.

You want to be coached.

You’re comfortable meeting new people.

You take pride in improving your performance.

You want significant earning potential.

And you’re looking for more than just another sales job.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Company\-provided leads **$100K\+ earning potential** Professional sales training **Ongoing coaching** Growing Chicago territory **Strong marketing support** Performance\-based compensation **Career advancement opportunities** An opportunity to grow with an expanding company

**READY TO GET STARTED?**

If you’re motivated, coachable, competitive, and interested in building a successful sales career with a growing company, we’d like to hear from you.

**Apply today to join Kitchen Revive Chicago.**

**Kitchen ReviveGreat leads. Great training. Great opportunity.**

Pay: $88,502\.16 \- $182,497\.23 per year

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

  

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Drive the Future of Healthcare with Data, AI, and Cloud


**Overview**

Oracle is seeking a high\-performing Data Platform Account Executive to help Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations transform how they leverage data, analytics, AI, and cloud technologies. This role focuses on strategic enterprise accounts across Providers, Payors, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Medical Device, and Research organizations, helping customers modernize data architectures and accelerate business outcomes through Oracle's industry\-leading Data Platform and Cloud portfolio.


If you thrive in complex enterprise sales, enjoy building executive relationships, and have a passion for helping customers solve critical business challenges, we'd love to meet you.


**What You'll Do**

* Develop and grow strategic Healthcare \& Life Sciences accounts.
* Build trusted relationships with C\-level executives and key business stakeholders.
* Drive sales of Oracle's Data Platform, Database, Analytics, AI, and Cloud solutions.
* Lead customer discussions around data modernization, AI adoption, analytics transformation, and digital innovation.
* Position Oracle as a strategic partner for multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud initiatives spanning OCI, AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Generate, manage, and close complex enterprise opportunities while maintaining a strong sales pipeline and forecast.
* Collaborate with Oracle's cloud, AI, industry, and solution engineering teams to deliver customer success.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8\+ years of successful enterprise technology sales experience.
* Experience selling Data Platform, Database, Analytics, AI, Cloud Infrastructure, SaaS, PaaS, or related solutions.
* Healthcare and/or Life Sciences industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success selling to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and other executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of exceeding quota and closing complex enterprise deals.
* Understanding of modern data architectures, AI/ML, analytics, and cloud technologies.
* Familiarity with multi\-cloud strategies involving OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Strong prospecting, account planning, communication, and executive presentation skills.

**Why Oracle**

Oracle delivers one of the industry's most complete portfolios across Data, AI, Analytics, Database, and Cloud Infrastructure. Our differentiated multi\-cloud strategy enables customers to innovate without compromise while leveraging the cloud platforms that best fit their business needs.


Join a team that is helping the world's leading healthcare and life sciences organizations unlock the power of data, accelerate AI adoption, and shape the future of their industries.


Apply today and help transform Healthcare through Data, AI, and Multi\-Cloud innovation.


  
Primary job duty is to sell technology software products and related services in a defined territory. Identifies, qualifies and closes new opportunities. Manages accounts including the entire sales process from business development prospecting and specifications through contract negotiations, signing, and post\-sales support. Leverages the Oracle sales model to maximize revenue growth and increase local market share. Builds and expands business partner revenue and self sufficiency.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Representative**
-------------------------------


**Location:** Aurora, IL, 60504
**Company Overview**
Since our doors opened in 1989, Reliable Medical has been committed to improving the lives of all who entrust us with their care and those who we entrust to provide it. We strive to be the premier provider of complex mobility solutions and other critical services for customers seeking compassionate care and optimal outcomes. Our mission is to improve the lives of those we serve by providing best in class service to customers, education, product expertise and dedicated partnership to clinicians, and development, career satisfaction and work\-life balance to our team members. We aspire to bring our mission to new communities and to reinvest our growth into improving lives, treating one another and our customers, like family.
**Job Description**
We are seeking a motivated and results driven Inside Sales Representative to join our team. As an Inside Sales Representative, you will play a key role in expanding our customer base and driving revenue growth by effectively promoting and selling our range of home medical equipment to healthcare providers, clinics, and individual customers. Your primary responsibilities will include proactively reaching out to prospective clients, providing product information, offering personalized solutions, and closing sales deals. This is an excellent opportunity for a talented individual with a passion for healthcare and sales to make a significant impact on our organization's success.



**Essential Functions**
* Sales Generation:
	+ Actively prospect, qualify, and generate new sales leads through outbound calls, emails, and other communication channels.
	+ Conduct thorough needs assessments to understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate home medical equipment solutions.
	+ Effectively communicate product features, benefits, and pricing information to prospective customers.
	+ Collaborate with the sales team to achieve sales targets and revenue objectives.
* Relationship Building:
	+ Build and maintain strong, long\-lasting relationships with existing and potential customers.
	+ Provide exceptional customer service by promptly responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and addressing concerns.
	+ Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities to maximize customer value and satisfaction.
	+ Stay updated on industry trends, competitor products, and market conditions to effectively position our offerings.
* Sales Process Management:
	+ Utilize CRM software to manage and track leads, sales activities, and customer interactions.
	+ Prepare and deliver persuasive sales presentations, quotes, and proposals.
	+ Negotiate and close sales deals while ensuring profitability and customer satisfaction.
	+ Collaborate with internal departments, including operations and logistics, to ensure smooth order processing and timely delivery of products.
* Product Knowledge and Training:
	+ Develop a comprehensive understanding of our home medical equipment product line.
	+ Stay informed about industry regulations, product updates, and technological advancements.
	+ Participate in training sessions and product demonstrations to enhance product knowledge and sales techniques.

**Qualifications and Requirements**
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in business administration, Sales, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous experience in selling home medical equipment or healthcare\-related products is advantageous.
* Familiarity with medical terminology and basic understanding of insurance billing processes is a plus.
* Proven experience as an Inside Sales Representative or in a similar sales role.
* Strong track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.

jobs.description:
**About Wonder**


Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.


Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot.


Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Opportunity**
-------------------------


Wonder is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and strategic Executive Assistant to support key executive leaders—specifically supporting two CEOs who oversee our largest business units, our CTO, and other executives. This role serves as a trusted partner to executive leadership, managing complex administrative operations, communications, scheduling, and cross\-functional coordination in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, exercises exceptional judgment and discretion, anticipates needs before they arise, and brings a high level of professionalism, curiosity, and operational excellence to everything they do.


This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role in supporting executive leadership while helping drive organizational effectiveness and operational efficiency across Wonder.

**The Impact You Will Make**

**Executive Partnership \& Calendar Management**
------------------------------------------------

* Provide high\-level administrative and operational support to CEO, CTO and other C\-Suite level leaders
* Manage complex executive calendars, prioritizing competing demands and aligning schedules with business priorities
* Coordinate and support executive meetings with internal and external stakeholders, including board members, investors, and senior leadership
* Anticipate executive needs, proactively solve problems, and improve administrative workflows and processes
* Track priorities, deadlines, deliverables, and follow\-up items with minimal direction
* Serve as a trusted liaison across internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless coordination and communication

**Communication \& Documentation**
----------------------------------

* Draft, edit, proofread, and distribute executive communications, presentations, and messaging for a variety of audiences
* Communicate professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including executives, board members, investors, and external partners
* Maintain highly confidential information, files, records, and correspondence with discretion and professionalism

**Meeting \& Event Coordination**
---------------------------------

* Plan and coordinate executive leadership meetings, business reviews, offsites, town halls, and strategic planning sessions
* Manage meeting logistics including scheduling, room coordination, vendor management, agendas, materials, and follow\-up actions
* Support both virtual and in\-person meetings across multiple time zones and locations
* Assist with coordination of board meetings and executive\-level events as needed

**Office \& Operational Excellence**
------------------------------------

* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, and related logistics
* Prepare and process expense reports, invoices, budgets, and administrative documentation
* Ensure efficient day\-to\-day operations of the executive offices and contribute to a positive team environment
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and administrative processes across the organization

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 4\-6\+ years of experience supporting C\-level executives, preferably within fast\-paced or high\-growth environments
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism handling confidential and sensitive information
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* Proven ability to anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and operate independently
* High attention to detail and strong follow\-through
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive, with experience operating within a highly collaborative Google\-based work environment
* Experience supporting executive leadership in finance, operations, technology, or high\-growth startup environments is a plus

**Got These? Even Better:**

* Experience coordinating board meetings, investor communications, or executive\-level presentations is preferred
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred


As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role.


This role requires a minimum of 4 days a week in the office, with additional days as needed based on role demands.

**Illinois:** $86,500\-$103,000 per year.

new_jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Student Support Services
  
  

Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| Benefited \| Onsite \| Hourly Rate $30\.00
  
  

About CSUDH Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
The California State University, Dominguez Hills (CSUDH) Toro Auxiliary Partners was established in 1968 to serve as a strategic partner of the university. The Auxiliary provides essential services, supports innovative programs, and enhances initiatives that are integral to the university’s educational mission.
  
  

About CSU Dominguez Hills
  
Founded in 1960, CSU Dominguez Hills is one of 23 campuses in the California State University system. The university is recognized for its rich diversity and serves as a vital educational hub for the South Bay region of Los Angeles County. Its mission is to foster academic excellence and community engagement in a dynamic, metropolitan environment.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Program Coordinator plays a central role in the day\-to\-day operation of the TRIO SSS program, with primary responsibility for planning, coordinating, and facilitating the workshops, events, and programmatic activities that support participant success. The Coordinator designs and delivers workshops on topics such as academic skill\-building, financial literacy, career and graduate school exploration, and personal development; organizes cultural and campus enrichment events; and coordinates program\-wide activities such as orientation, recognition ceremonies, and off\-campus trips. The Coordinator is also responsible for collecting, entering, and maintaining participant data and outcome assessments to support grant compliance and program evaluation, and serves as a primary point of contact for participants, providing responsive, high\-quality customer service. This position works under the general direction of the Director and collaborates closely with SSS advisors, tutors, and campus partners.
  
  

This is a full\-time, benefited, onsite position with an hourly rate of $30\.00\.
  
  

Position Benefits
  
Toro Auxiliary Partners offers comprehensive benefits, including employer\-sponsored health, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement plans, and paid sick/vacation leave.
  
  

Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

Workshop, Event, and Program Coordination
  
  

* Plan, develop, and facilitate workshops and skill\-building sessions for participants covering topics such as study skills, time management, financial literacy, financial aid and scholarship processes, career exploration, graduate school preparation, and college readiness and enrollment.
* Design and coordinate program events and activities, including orientation, recognition and graduation ceremonies, cultural enrichment trips, campus activities, and social/community\-building events, from concept through execution.
* Manage event logistics including scheduling, facility and room reservations, catering, transportation arrangements, invitations, RSVPs, and on\-site setup and staffing.
* Develop and maintain an annual workshop and events calendar aligned with grant objectives and participant needs, adjusting programming based on participation trends and feedback.
* Recruit, train, and coordinate peer mentors, guest speakers, presenters, and campus/community partners to support workshops and events.
* Promote workshops and events through email, social media, flyers, the program website/learning management system, and direct outreach to maximize participant engagement.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of workshops and events through participant feedback and outcome data, and use findings to improve future programming.


Data Collection, Assessment, and Reporting
  
  

* Collect, enter, and maintain accurate participant data in program databases (e.g., Blumen, TRIO software, or institutional systems), including attendance, workshop participation, academic progress, and service contacts.
* Administer and track participant needs assessments, satisfaction surveys, and outcome assessments to measure progress toward grant objectives (retention, good academic standing, persistence, and graduation/transfer rates).
* Maintain up\-to\-date, compliant participant files and documentation in accordance with federal TRIO grant requirements and institutional record\-keeping policies, including FERPA.
* Prepare regular reports summarizing workshop attendance, event participation, and program outcomes for the Director and for the U.S. Department of Education Annual Performance Report (APR).
* Assist with program evaluation activities and continuous improvement efforts based on assessment data.


Participant and Customer Service
  
  

* Serve as a welcoming, responsive first point of contact for prospective and current participants, faculty, and staff, in person, by phone, and by email.
* Provide accurate information about program services, eligibility, workshops, and events, and resolve participant questions or concerns promptly and professionally.
* Support participant recruitment and intake, including verifying eligibility documentation and processing applications.
* Build positive, trust\-based relationships with participants to encourage sustained engagement with program services.

**Who We Are:**


Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.


Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities, have served over 100 million meals, and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 1,500\+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. **About the Company**

GP Tech Services LLC is seeking an exceptional **Project Manager / Executive Assistant** to work closely with senior leadership and support the coordination and execution of high\-profile international projects for **Byborg Enterprises**.

Byborg Enterprises is a global digital entertainment company with a diverse portfolio spanning streaming, film, publishing, creator platforms, membership products, and internationally recognized brands, including Playboy through licensing partnerships.

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced, highly organized professional who is equally comfortable managing complex projects, coordinating senior\-level stakeholders, handling confidential information, and supporting an executive in a fast\-moving international environment.

**About the Role**

The Project Manager / Executive Assistant will work closely with senior leadership to coordinate multiple projects from initial concept through execution. The role combines **project management, executive support, business coordination, and partner management**.

Projects may span:

* Online entertainment and streaming
* Film and scripted entertainment
* Film production and long\-form content
* Paysites, fansites, and creator platforms
* Digital publications
* Membership and digital media products
* International brand and commercial partnerships

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Management**

* Maintain a comprehensive project portfolio across multiple business areas, with clearly defined owners, milestones, priorities, and deadlines.
* Track project progress and ensure agreed actions are completed on time.
* Prepare for meetings, organize agendas and materials, document key decisions, and follow up to ensure decisions are implemented.
* Coordinate information and materials required by management and the Board.
* Identify outstanding issues, dependencies, and potential delays and ensure they are appropriately escalated.

**Executive Support**

* Manage the executive's calendar, travel arrangements, correspondence, and day\-to\-day scheduling.
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, meeting notes, and other documents as required.
* Coordinate complex international travel and itineraries.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion.

**Partner \& Supplier Management**

* Coordinate external partners, vendors, agencies, and suppliers from initial contact through agreement and execution.
* Support negotiations and ensure that commercial, production, marketing, and legal requirements remain aligned.
* Follow up on contracts, approvals, deliverables, and outstanding actions.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Act as a central point of coordination between production, marketing, legal, management, and external partners.
* Ensure all relevant stakeholders have the information they need to keep projects moving forward.
* Maintain organized records of contracts, approvals, project documentation, and key communications.

**Travel**

* Travel periodically to productions, events, partner meetings, and other business activities in the United States and internationally.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, commercially minded professional who can move comfortably between strategic discussions and detailed execution.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Proven experience as a **Project Manager, Producer, Executive Assistant, Operations Manager, or in a comparable commercial role**.
* Experience in entertainment, media, digital businesses, technology, or another fast\-moving international environment is highly valued.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with both **budgets and contracts as well as schedules, deadlines, and project plans**.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work with senior executives and external partners.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality.
* Comfortable working in a business environment that includes adult and glamour content. Our brands are premium and our portfolio is broad, with part of the business operating in the adult entertainment sector.
* Valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.
* **Hungarian language skills are a plus.**

**This is a highly mobile international position!**

Depending on business and project requirements, the successful candidate should expect to spend approximately **six months of the year in the United States and six months traveling internationally**.

All company\-related travel and accommodation will be arranged and covered by the company.

* Paid time off (PTO)
* Paid sick time
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance

* 401(k)
* Company\-paid business travel and accommodation
* Direct exposure to senior decision\-makers and international business operations
* Meaningful involvement in projects from early\-stage development through commercial execution
* The opportunity to work across film, digital entertainment, publishing, creator platforms, and international brand development

The role is particularly suited to someone who combines **strong organizational discipline with commercial awareness, discretion, initiative, and the ability to make things happen.**

* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

new_jobs.description:
**Join our team as a Digital Marketing Manager at Quorum Hospitality!**



Are you a results\-driven marketer who thrives on performance and strategy? As the **Digital Marketing Manager**, you'll be responsible for the digital presence and performance of our multi\-brand hotel portfolio, including brand.com and property websites, search engine optimization (SEO), and paid media across search, display, and social channels. You'll partner closely with our Director of Marketing, property General Managers and sales teams, brand digital marketing programs, and outside agencies to drive direct bookings, lower cost of guest acquisition, and strengthen brand and property visibility across the portfolio.

  


**Salary:** $105,000 \- $115,000 / year.

  


**Location**: This position supports a flexible **hybrid** work model, with on\-site requirements based on the employee's location relative to our Newport Beach office.



* **Orange County residents:** Two days per week in the office.
* **Los Angeles, San Diego, and other surrounding areas:** Two in\-office days per month.
  





**Your Role:**



As our Corporate Marketing Manager, you'll own digital performance across our hotel portfolio, from websites to paid media to organic search. Some of your responsibilities will include:


* Manage the day\-to\-day content accuracy, updates, and performance of property, corporate, and independent/restaurant websites, including hosting, design updates, and content refreshes.
* Coordinate with brand digital teams and vendors on brand.com and OTA content, imagery, and merchandising for each property.
* Monitor site analytics and report on traffic, conversion rate, and direct booking metrics.
* Develop and execute SEO strategy across all properties, including keyword research, on\-page optimization, and local SEO, and track rankings and organic visibility by market and property.
* Manage Google Business Profiles at the property level, including listings accuracy, photos, posts, and review response.
* Manage planning, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns across paid search, metasearch, paid social, and OTAs, including brand\-specific programs and budgets (Hilton Advance, Beacon, Amplify/Elevate, Marriott PLUS).
* Own budget pacing, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative testing, and monthly performance reporting across all paid channels.
* Oversee organic social content calendars and community management across property and restaurant group accounts.
* Partner with Revenue Management to align digital marketing spend and messaging with rate strategy and demand calendars, and maintain a monthly digital marketing dashboard for ownership and property leadership.
* Manage relationships and contracts with external SEO, web, and paid media agencies as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3–5\+ years of digital marketing experience, ideally within hospitality, multi\-unit retail/restaurant, or multi\-location services businesses.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Business Profile, and a major CMS (WordPress or brand\-proprietary platforms).
* Familiarity with hotel brand digital ecosystems is a strong plus (e.g., Hilton Advance/Amplify/Beacon, Marriott PLUS/Marriott Digital Services/Koddi).
* A high school diploma or equivalent is required; a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations for non\-marketing stakeholders.
* Excellent project management skills; comfortable managing multiple properties, brands, and vendors simultaneously.

  


**What We'll Do For You:**


* **Health Benefits –** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance available starting the first of the month after just 30 days. *(Full\-time team members)*
* **Holidays \& Paid Time Off –** Take time to relax and recharge. *(For eligible team members)*
* **401(k) Retirement Plan –** Secure your future with our generous company match.
* **Education Program –** Further your career with our tuition reimbursement program.
* **Hotel Travel Discounts –** Explore the world with special rates.
* **Daily Pay –** Access your earnings when you need them.

  


**Why Join Quorum Hospitality?**



Quorum Hospitality, ranked among the nation's leading hotel management companies, has been delivering value\-driven hospitality solutions since 1987\. Our diverse portfolio features renowned hospitality brands such as Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG, highlighting our commitment to excellence in customized management. Our team is dedicated to building strong relationships and providing exceptional service that benefits guests, owners, and team members alike. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, and Newport Beach, California, we pride ourselves on fostering a culture of integrity and innovation.


Equal Opportunity Employer

* Keep lead and project tracking sheets accurate and up to date.
* Track lead stages, project stages, next follow\-up dates, notes, and customer communication.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers, fabricators, installers, demolition contractors, and other project partners.
