* Help identify missing information, scheduling issues, or project details that need clarification.
* Support the transition from accepted estimate to active project.
* Monitor project milestones to help ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Assist with payment follow\-up, project documentation, and post\-installation follow\-up.
* Help maintain a professional and organized customer experience from first inquiry through project completion.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3\+ years of experience in a coordinator, administrative, customer service, showroom, sales support, scheduling, or operations role.
* Experience in construction, home services, interior design, flooring, tile, cabinetry, countertops, remodeling, or a showroom environment is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple leads, tasks, and projects at the same time.
* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and email.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately track notes, dates, statuses, and next steps.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets, spreadsheets, calendars, email, and basic digital tools.
* Ability to follow systems, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Proactive follow\-up style; able to keep things moving without constant reminders.
* Professional, friendly, and customer\-focused communication style.
* Comfortable working with contractors, vendors, and internal team members.
* Able to work in a small business environment where priorities can shift quickly.
* Willingness to learn about stone materials, fabrication, installation, and the overall renovation process.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Salary range: **$60,000–$80,000 per year**, depending on experience.
* Opportunity for performance\-based bonuses.
* Growth opportunity into a larger operations, sales coordination, or project management role.
* Hands\-on training in stone materials, fabrication, installation, customer management, and project coordination.
* Opportunity to play a key role in improving systems, customer experience, and project workflow within a growing company.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

new_jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part Time)
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.


Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities, have served over 100 million meals, and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 1,500\+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements** **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set\-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem\-solve, and ensure high quality set\-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem\-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point\-of\-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real\-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set\-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch Monday\- Friday (10am\- 2pm)

  

**Benefits** **What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages $20\-$23/hr
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long\-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda

* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Scale
new_jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------


At Affinity, we're passionate about our customers' success and looking for a resourceful, results driven Customer Success Specialist to join our Scale team. This role blends two things: managing a large, global portfolio of Scale customers day to day, and helping build the scalable, one to many programs that let a lean team deliver a great experience across a much larger book than a traditional 1:1 CSM model allows.


You'll manage a book of Scale accounts as part of a pooled model, driving adoption, mitigating renewal risk, and expanding revenue, while also building the playbooks, programs, triggers, and campaigns that not only support activation for the Scale book, but also for the whole customer base. You'll partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Product, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the customer journey feels coordinated from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

**Account management**

* Manage a large and global portfolio of customers, including CRM workflow support, renewal risk, and revenue expansion opportunities.
* Leverage high touch and one to many tactics to drive positive customer outcomes and help users work Affinity into their daily tech stack.
* Mitigate risk by proactively identifying and flagging churn risk early in the contract cycle.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product and make workflow recommendations to drive adoption and engagement.
* Proactively identify customers who may not be maximizing Affinity and engage them to drive up monthly active users and seat expansion.
* Work cross functionally to provide effective and productive customer engagements.
* Function as the voice of the customer, identifying trends and feeding them back internally.

**Program design and journey work**

* Help design and continuously improve programs across the Scale customer journey, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Help identify which moments need a scaled, tech touch program versus a 1:1 touch, and build the playbooks and triggers (health score, usage signals, journey stage) that route accounts appropriately.
* Use product usage and health score data to build programs that increase adoption of core Affinity features and AI capabilities, including MCP, across the Scale book.
* Help identify the highest leverage touchpoints and design campaigns, in app messaging, and outreach sequences that move accounts through activation milestones.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Take a data first approach to designing and implementing engagement strategies at scale.
* Track the KPIs that matter for the Scale segment (activation rate, adoption, retention, expansion ARR, GRR) and report regularly on program and portfolio performance.
* Share insights that help shape Affinity's overall scale strategy.

**How you'll work**
-------------------

* Partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Onboarding, Product, and Lifecycle so the customer journey feels coordinated rather than duplicated across teams.
* Use data (Salesforce, Amplitude, etc.) to prioritize which accounts need attention and which programs to build next.
* Build with AI and automation first, using triggers and personalization to make one to many programs feel tailored.
* Operate with the pace and iteration mindset of a hyper growth CS org: ship a program, measure it, adjust it.
* Orchestrate cross functional resources to ensure the success of your clients.

**Qualifications**
------------------


Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Affinity, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align with the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Required**

* 1\-2 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, CS programs, CS operations, Lifecycle Marketing, or similar role.
* Track record of achieving commercial targets and goals, preferably in an enterprise SaaS setting.
* Experience managing high volumes of accounts at scale, driving adoption and renewals.
* Experience designing or running scalable, tech touch programs for a large book of accounts, not just 1:1 account management.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a history of building strong business relationships.
* A clear communicator, comfortable presenting your work to teammates and cross functional partners.
* Skilled at analyzing customer and usage data to build actionable programs and measure outcomes.
* Proficient in organization, account prioritization, project management, and time management.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and programs simultaneously, and ship in a fast paced, high growth environment.
* You are excited by the startup environment and enjoy contributing to a team that's still building out its structure and process as it scales.

**Nice to have**

* Experience at a SaaS company in the CRM or data services space.
* Experience with financial services clients, or in VC, private equity, investment banking, or other private capital verticals.
* Proficiency with tools like Salesforce, AI first CS platforms like Sonora, marketing automation tools like Customer.io or Pardot, Notion, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar).
* Familiarity with Affinity's MCP / AI ecosystem or similar AI driven CS tooling.
* A creative problem solver who challenges the status quo, with a curiosity for data and a habit of digging into results to surface trends.

**Location: San Francisco or New York**

*For this role we're embracing a hub\-hybrid model, designed to balance flexibility with meaningful in\-person collaboration. Team members within commuting distance are expected in\-office 2 days per week, typically Tuesday through Thur

new_jobs.description:
We are hiring an Entry Level Sales Representative to join our growing sales team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, communicating with customers, and developing professional sales skills. As an Entry Level Sales Representative, you will work directly with customers to explain AT\&T products and services, answer questions, and help customers find solutions that fit their needs.

You will receive training on AT\&T wireless products, plans, devices, and services. The Entry Level Sales Representative role provides hands\-on experience in sales, customer service, communication, and relationship building. Bilingual candidates who are comfortable communicating in both English and Spanish are encouraged to apply.

**Entry Level Sales Representative Responsibilities**

* Speak with customers in person to understand their needs and recommend appropriate AT\&T products and services.
* Explain wireless plans, devices, features, and service options clearly and accurately.
* Provide customer service in both English and Spanish when needed.
* Answer customer questions and address concerns throughout the sales process.
* Build positive relationships with customers through professional and effective communication.
* Assist customers with selecting products and services that fit their individual needs.
* Maintain accurate customer information, leads, and follow\-up records.
* Follow up with customers to answer questions and provide additional assistance.
* Represent AT\&T professionally during all customer interactions.
* Work toward Entry Level Sales Representative goals while maintaining a positive customer experience.

**Entry Level Sales Representative Qualifications**

* Bilingual in English and Spanish required.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable speaking with customers in a face\-to\-face environment.
* Motivated, dependable, and willing to learn.
* Ability to work in a goal\-oriented sales environment.
* Strong organization and follow\-up skills.
* Previous sales or customer service experience is helpful but not required.
* Ability to learn product information and communicate it clearly to customers.

This Entry Level Sales Representative position offers an opportunity to gain hands\-on sales experience while developing valuable communication, customer service, and professional skills.

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

From an idea in one man's garage to an essential in every man's shower, Every Man Jack was created to give men everywhere clean, effective personal care that stands up to any adventure.

--------------------------------


Redis is the platform developers trust for real\-time data—and the platform an increasing share of AI applications are built on. AI agents can identify a need, decide which solution fits, review technical documentation, and create a new account within one continuous session.


The Lead, Growth Marketing owns the Redis digital surface for both agents and humans. This includes the website, SEO, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, conversion\-rate optimization, and the measurement system that connects discovery to pipeline, account creation, and activation.


Your central challenge is to streamline agent\-led growth: making Redis easy for agents to discover, understand, recommend, evaluate, and select while ensuring the same digital experience converts human developers and buyers.

* Strong executive communication and the willingness to move between strategy and hands\-on work.

Via Collective is hiring a part\-time, hybrid Project Coordinator in NYC ($20–$30/hr) to support Project Directors and Managers in tracking schedules, budgets, communication, and resource planning for signage and wayfinding projects. The role requires 2–4 years of coordination experience, strong organizational skills, and proficiency in tools like Asana and Adobe Creative Suite.


### **Description**


At Via Collective, we’re passionate about crafting experiences that guide and connect people to their environments. The Project Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the successful delivery of signage and wayfinding projects by coordinating project information, schedules, resources, budgets, and communications across multidisciplinary teams.


The Project Coordinator is a project support and coordination role working under the direction of the Project Director and/or Project Manager. The position is responsible for organizing information, tracking project activities, coordinating communication and resources, and identifying items that require the attention or decision of the Project Director/Manager. Final decision\-making for project direction, client decisions, scope, contracts, and project approvals remains with the Project Director/Manager.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day project activities, ensuring information flows efficiently between the Project Director/Manager, clients, consultants, and the internal design team.
* Maintain strong working relationships through responsive, supportive, and professional client communication
* Under the direction of the Project Director/Manager:
	+ Coordinate communications with clients, subconsultants, and vendors under the direction of the Project Director/Manager, ensuring questions, information, and follow\-up items are routed appropriately.
	+ Maintain and monitor project schedules, milestones, and action items
	+ Build, update, and maintain projects in Asana
	+ Coordinate project meetings by scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, documenting meeting notes, tracking follow\-up actions, and following up as necessary
	+ Track project budgets and progress, escalating potential risks or schedule impacts to the Project Director/Manager.
	+ Maintain and update staff resource planning to be able to see all projects and staffing resources simultaneously every week
	+ Support the design team in preparing project deliverables, transmittals, updating client comment logs, and maintaining and resolving RFI logs.
	+ Track project decisions, outstanding issues, and scope changes throughout the project lifecycle.
	+ Prepare draft scope change documentation and added scope requests (ASRs) for review and approval by Project Director/Manager.
	+ Support improvements to project workflows, documentation, and coordination processes.
	+ Support Project Managers on larger, more complex projects as assigned.
* Follow company policies and procedures, including folder and file organization, naming, and structure.
* Support the firm’s QA/QC process by reviewing project materials for completeness, accuracy, formatting, and adherence to established project standards before client distribution.
* Attend weekly internal design team coordination meetings to report on and coordinate your projects, weekly resource planning meetings to coordinate designer assignments, and external project meetings as needed.

### **Qualifications**

new_jobs.title: Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

  


**Position Summary:**

  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Coordinator.

  

  

Responsible for providing moderate to advanced range of coordination of Research studies conducted at the Medical Center, assists with the recruitment, enrollment, grant submissions, research data collection and study coordination activities. Performs intra\-operative monitoring and serves as liaison with internal and external funding agencies. Ensures the accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPAA, and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator, Research Team and sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and Principal Investigator in support of the clinical trials if applicable. Establishes liaisons with relevant parties at the Medical Center that may include: Research Nurses, Research Pharmacists, Program Managers, Medical Technicians, Clinical Information Systems and regulatory Services. Might assist in the initiation and management of research studies. Works independently, under general direction.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**

  


* Grants \-Prepares and submit grant applications and other grants related an activity such as developing grants applications/proposals and fund raising activities if applicable. Collects and organizes required paperwork for submission if applicable. Follow up and coordinates resolution of all issues progress. Reports to the sponsors to fund medical research in the division.
* Human Subjects' Research \- As applicable, oversee the submission of necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research (e.g., ensures the update and submission of necessary documents and/or forms to appropriate destination). Might prepare, audit and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials, and provides other information in timely manner, as necessary.
* Study Regulations \- Aware of study regulatory status and keep an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Assists with the informed consent process and ensure that the patient/subject fully understands what is required of them throughout the study. Follows through regularly with the patient/subjects reminding them of visits and compliance. May monitor any outward effects or issues regarding patient/subject safety and report this to the Principal Investigator, Physician and Research Nurse.
* Data Management \- Responsible for collecting and auditing patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Audits and manages data from and into the database. Prepares forms and reports, compiles and analyses data, statistics, and other materials for reports. Conducts study visits, obtains and documents information within the time frame specified.
* Budget \- Develops a preliminary draft budget and submit to the Director/Principal Investigator. Reviews sponsor\-proposed budget for adequate coverage and recommend changes as appropriate. Assists in the preparation of funding reports to funding agencies and helps identify new potential sponsors/agents for trials and researches. Monitor budget throughout trial.
* Decision Making and Problems Solving Combines and evaluates information and data to make decisions about relative importance of information and choosing the best solution to solve problems. Resolves complex situations and refers non solved issues and questions with recommendation to supervisor.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.
* Recruitment \- Screens potential patients/subjects for eligibility to the study. This may include gathering information from the medical record, physician referral, advertisement and directly scheduling a visit to evaluate the patient/subject. Reviews all the elements of the screening process with the Principal Investigator that being: inclusion/exclusion criteria, completed informed consent, documentation of the event and the patient/subject willingness to participate in the study.
* Clinical Competency \- competency in performing EKG, phlebotomy technique, centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Other trainings and competencies may be included as required.
* Continuous Learning \- Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development (training programs are provided through the SOM). Promotes own professional growth and development in research role and maintains current expertise in area of practice. Maintains annual requirement of 10 CEUs in continuing research

**The Role**
------------


At Affinity, we're passionate about our customers' success and looking for a resourceful, results driven Customer Success Specialist to join our Scale team. This role blends two things: managing a large, global portfolio of Scale customers day to day, and helping build the scalable, one to many programs that let a lean team deliver a great experience across a much larger book than a traditional 1:1 CSM model allows.


You'll manage a book of Scale accounts as part of a pooled model, driving adoption, mitigating renewal risk, and expanding revenue, while also building the playbooks, programs, triggers, and campaigns that not only support activation for the Scale book, but also for the whole customer base. You'll partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Product, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the customer journey feels coordinated from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

**Account management**

* Manage a large and global portfolio of customers, including CRM workflow support, renewal risk, and revenue expansion opportunities.
* Leverage high touch and one to many tactics to drive positive customer outcomes and help users work Affinity into their daily tech stack.
* Mitigate risk by proactively identifying and flagging churn risk early in the contract cycle.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product and make workflow recommendations to drive adoption and engagement.
* Proactively identify customers who may not be maximizing Affinity and engage them to drive up monthly active users and seat expansion.
* Work cross functionally to provide effective and productive customer engagements.
* Function as the voice of the customer, identifying trends and feeding them back internally.

**Program design and journey work**

* Help design and continuously improve programs across the Scale customer journey, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Help identify which moments need a scaled, tech touch program versus a 1:1 touch, and build the playbooks and triggers (health score, usage signals, journey stage) that route accounts appropriately.
* Use product usage and health score data to build programs that increase adoption of core Affinity features and AI capabilities, including MCP, across the Scale book.
* Help identify the highest leverage touchpoints and design campaigns, in app messaging, and outreach sequences that move accounts through activation milestones.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Take a data first approach to designing and implementing engagement strategies at scale.
* Track the KPIs that matter for the Scale segment (activation rate, adoption, retention, expansion ARR, GRR) and report regularly on program and portfolio performance.
* Share insights that help shape Affinity's overall scale strategy.

**How you'll work**
-------------------

* Partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Onboarding, Product, and Lifecycle so the customer journey feels coordinated rather than duplicated across teams.
* Use data (Salesforce, Amplitude, etc.) to prioritize which accounts need attention and which programs to build next.
* Build with AI and automation first, using triggers and personalization to make one to many programs feel tailored.
* Operate with the pace and iteration mindset of a hyper growth CS org: ship a program, measure it, adjust it.
* Orchestrate cross functional resources to ensure the success of your clients.

**Qualifications**
------------------


Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. * Experience managing high volumes of accounts at scale, driving adoption and renewals.

**Nice to have**

* Experience at a SaaS company in the CRM or data services space.
* Experience with financial services clients, or in VC, private equity, investment banking, or other private capital verticals.

**About the Role**

This role will partner closely with Jake Poses, Chief Product Officer, and Arnaud Ferreri, Chief Technology Officer, to maximize their effectiveness — ensuring their time, attention, and preparation are focused on the product, technology, people, and decisions that matter most.


The role extends well beyond traditional executive support. A great Executive Assistant anticipates what’s needed, builds structure where it’s missing, exercises sound judgment, and owns work through resolution. They deeply learn how each executive operates and translate that understanding into tailored support \- creating leverage without requiring every need or next step to be explicitly defined.


Working closely with Jake, Arnaud, and the R\&D Chief of Staff, this person will help create a seamless operating environment around R\&D leadership. Ultimately, success is measured by outcomes, not tasks: Jake and Arnaud are focused on their highest\-impact work, consistently prepared for important moments, and supported by an EA whose effectiveness and ownership compound as their context and trust deepen.


**What You'll Own**


* Time \& Calendar \| You'll own Jake and Arnaud's calendars end\-to\-end — aligning time to their highest\-priority work, protecting focus and preparation, filtering and reshaping requests, and navigating competing demands across two executives.
* Executive Operations \| You'll build the systems that keep both executives running effectively \- across priorities, tasks, follow\-up, information flow, travel, and day\-to\-day logistics \- tailored to how each works and continuously improved as you learn them.
* Meeting Preparation \| You'll ensure Jake and Arnaud are prepared for the moments that matter \- coordinating context and materials, engaging the right stakeholders early, protecting preparation time, and anticipating what they need before they walk into the room.
* Team \& R\&D Operations \| You'll support the operating needs of two large, fast\-growing organizations — planning leadership and team offsites, coordinating events and key team moments, and owning the logistics that enable Product and Engineering to operate effectively.
* Communications \& Follow\-Through \| You'll help manage communication and coordination across email, Slack, and key stakeholders \- ensuring important information gets to the right place, commitments are tracked, and loops are reliably closed.
* Executive Partnership \| The connective tissue across all of the above. You'll deeply learn how Jake and Arnaud each operate, anticipate where support is needed, exercise independent judgment, and take ownership without waiting for every next step to be defined

**You'd Be a Great Fit If…**


* You take ownership instinctively \- you see what needs to happen, step into gaps, and stay with problems through resolution.
* You exercise independent judgment without overstepping — and know when to act, ask, escalate, or push back.
* You learn your executives quickly — how they think, work, and prioritize — and adapt your support without needing every preference or next step spelled out.
* You build business and R\&D context quickly and use it to make better decisions, not just become more informed.
* You enjoy supporting large, fast\-moving teams — from complex calendars and leadership rhythms to offsites, events, and the details that make an organization run smoothly.
* You measure success by Jake and Arnaud’s effectiveness, not tasks completed — and are comfortable challenging an initial ask when you believe a different approach will produce a better outcome.

**Compensation \& Benefits**


Comprehensive total rewards package including equity, health/wellness benefits, and retirement savings.


Benefits include: Equity Compensation (RSUs) · Medical, Dental, Vision · HSA/FSA · 401K · Work\-from\-Home Stipend · Therapy Reimbursement · 16\-week parental leave · Carrot Fertility · 13 paid holidays \+ Holiday Break (Dec 25–31\) · Flexible PTO · EAP · Training and professional development

* Develop and execute disease\-specific sales account plans for major academic centers, hospitals, IDNs, community accounts, and other priority sites of care; map stakeholders, patient journeys, diagnostic workflows, referral pathways, and account factors that influence therapy adoption


* Identify gaps in diagnostic workflows, referral pathways, operational readiness, clinical protocol adoption, and stakeholder alignment; implement solutions to optimize appropriate therapy adoption


* Drive clinical advocacy and education by building relationships with account stakeholders and developing clinical champions across hematology, hem/onc, internal medicine, nephrology, transplant, pharmacy, clinical administration, and other relevant specialties


* Deliver approved clinical messaging to influence brand choice, support appropriate formulary access, and educate clinical stakeholders on disease state, unmet needs, diagnostic criteria, and therapy integration


* Support account stakeholder understanding of operational considerations related to therapy implementation, including treatment workflow, pharmacy, infusion, and other site\-of\-care processes, and engage appropriate internal partners when broader institutional action is needed


* Educate on fulfillment processes, payer access policies, reimbursement frameworks, and common account\-wide operational barriers related to prior authorization, access resources and support.


* Mobilize cross\-functional teams, including SAL(s), FRM(s), PEM(s), TLL(s), MSL(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, and enterprise partners, to deliver on account objectives and resolve barriers


* Represent customer priorities internally and advocate for solutions that address account\-specific needs while maintaining appropriate role boundaries


* Create and maintain account and indication\-specific business plans that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces, institution dynamics, care delivery models, access considerations, and multi\-stakeholder decision\-making.


* Handle customer questions and objections in a way that is consistent with product indications and sales training methodology, including the ability to compliantly triage inquiries to the appropriate partner


* Effectively utilize CRM tools to manage territory priorities, track account engagement, document sales activities, and submit required reports accurately and on time; and adopt CRM AI\-embedded tools to prioritize opportunities and optimize call execution


* Effectively use AI\-driven insights for territory planning, HCP targeting, and pre\-call strategy; translate analytics into focused customer engagement and account action plans


* Provide a high level of product expertise and customer service across all assigned accounts, including complex accounts with multiple stakeholders and sites of care


* Perform work in alignment with and adhering to Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures


**What you bring:**


* Bachelor’s degree.


* 5\+ years of experience in specialty pharma, rare disease sales, account management, or complex institutional selling.


* Strong understanding of healthcare systems, reimbursement processes, fulfillment pathways, and multi\-stakeholder decision\-making in hospitals, academic centers, IDNs, and community care settings

* Excellent strategic planning, problem\-solving, account management, and communication skills


* Ability to understand and translate complex clinical data to activate clinical champions and build advocacy within Centers of Excellence, academic centers, hospitals, IDNs, and other sites of car

new_jobs.title: Travel Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. **This is a fully virtual work from home sales position for candidates who reside in the states of Florida, Georgia and South Carolina only. Candidates who reside outside of these states will not be considered.** Successful candidates must be able to meet our work at home requirements (see below).

**How You'll Shine:**


Are you passionate about travel and skilled in sales? Join our team as a Travel Sales Representative with Travel \+ Leisure! In this role, you’ll combine your love for customer service with your sales expertise to create unforgettable travel experiences for our clients. Here’s what you’ll do:

**Sales and Customer Service:** Take inbound calls from excited customers ready to plan their dream vacations. Your expertise will guide them through the booking process for car rentals, airfare, hotel reservations, cruises and local experiences.

**Subject Matter Expertise:** As a **Travel Sales Representative,** you’ll be the go\-to resource for our customers. Build rapport and recommend personalized, lifestyle\-aligned travel solutions—air, hotel, cruise, car, and local experiences—curated for each customer.

* **$17\.50 per hour plus monthly sales incentives based off your performance**
* **Start Date: Friday October 16th**

**What You'll Bring:**

* **Proven Sales Experience:** Demonstrated success in driving results through inbound service, outbound follow\-up, and relationship\-based selling.
* **Exceptional Interpersonal Skills:** Quickly establish rapport with customers, engage in meaningful conversations, and create lasting connections. You’ll ask probing questions to understand their travel needs and seamlessly offer additional services.
* **Strong Multitasking Abilities:** Thrive under pressure and handle multiple tasks effectively.
* **Education Requirement:** High School Diploma or GED is required.
* **Customer Service and Sales Experience:** Six months of experience in both areas.
* **Travel Experience Preferred:** Six months of travel\-related experience is a plus.
* **Technology Agility:** Comfortable managing several technology applications simultaneously (CRM, booking tools, payment systems, communication apps). Prior travel software knowledge (e.g., Amadeus, Apollo, Sabre, Worldspan) is helpful but not required; ability to learn quickly is essential.
* **Training Schedule:** A 5\-week training schedule from 11:00 am to 8:00 pm EST.
* **Post\-Training Availability:** Be available to work between 8:00 am and 10:00 pm EST Monday to Saturday with a set schedule provided.
* **Holiday Availability:** Ability to work some holidays.

**What is required for me to work from home?**

* Quiet workplace free of distractions and background noise
* High speed internet requirements Download speed of 20 mbps and upload speed of 3 mbps average ping below 100m
* Must be able to hardwire computer directly to a router
* Must have own personal device with a working camera to be used for the first week of training (until our computers reach your home)
* Intermediate computer proficiency and ability to troubleshoot technical issues while at home

**So what are you waiting for? Apply today to start your next career journey with Travel \& Leisure—where you’ll deliver not just trips, but unforgettable, concierge\-level experiences for every customer!**

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

new_jobs.title: Junior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Zep Inc.**

Zep Inc. is a leading manufacturer of cleaning solutions for businesses and consumers with operations across the U.S, Canada, and Europe. Our purpose is to make the planet cleaner, safer, and more productive. To fulfill our purpose, we focus on understanding and solving cleaning needs for consumers, as well as business customers across a variety of segments including transportation, industrial, institutional, and food \& beverage. We also have a strong presence in the consumer\-packaged goods (CPG) segment, where we develop products to help consumers and businesses maintain a clean and safe environment. Our products can be found online and at retail shelves at outlets like Home Depot, Amazon, Lowe’s, Ace Hardware, Grainger, HD Supply, Walmart, and many others. We market our products under well recognized and established brand names, such as Zep®, Enforcer®, Misty®, TimeMist®, TimeWick, and Country Vet®. Zep was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA. In 2021, Zep became the official cleaning partner of Atlanta United FC.


Job Description:


**Overview**

**This is project management beyond IT.** If you enjoy bringing people together, keeping projects moving, solving problems, and turning plans into results, this could be the opportunity for you.  



  

The **Junior Project Manager** will play a key role in driving cross\-functional business initiatives from idea to completion. You’ll work across multiple Zep business units—including Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Retail/Marketing, and OEM —to coordinate people, priorities, tasks, and timelines.  



  

This is **not an IT project management role** . While some projects may involve IT, the focus of this position is **business and operational project management** . You’ll partner with teams across the organization to make sure projects stay organized, milestones are met, issues are addressed, and commitments turn into results.  



  

You’ll be part of the PMO and gain exposure to the full project lifecycle, including **Initiation, Planning, Execution \& Monitoring, and Closing** .  



  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Projects move forward and are delivered **on time, within scope, and within budget**
* Teams know what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due
* Communication is **clear, proactive, and timely**
* Risks and roadblocks are identified early and addressed quickly
* Project information is organized, accurate, and easy to understand
* You build strong relationships and can effectively **influence without authority**
Leadership has a clear view of project progress and priorities  
* 

  

**What You'll Do**

* Manage approximately **8–10 cross\-functional projects and initiatives** at various stages of completion
* Partner with teams across **Supply Chain, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Retail/Marketing, OEM, and IT**
* Develop and maintain project plans, task lists, timelines, milestones, and deliverables
* Lead project kickoffs and recurring status meetings to keep teams aligned and moving forward
* Coordinate workstream activities and hold team members accountable for commitments
* Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues; proactively escalate concerns and help drive solutions
* Prepare concise meeting recaps with clear decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines
* Keep project plans and status information current and ensure executive dashboards accurately reflect progress
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and make project execution more effective
Build collaborative relationships across functions and serve as a central point of coordination throughout the project lifecycle  
* 

  

**Your Experience Includes**

* **1–2 years of project management experience** , with experience supporting or leading cross\-functional initiatives
* Experience managing multiple projects or priorities at the same time
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to **lead and influence without direct authority**
* Comfortable working through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex projects
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented approach to getting things done
* Ability to build trust, create accountability, and collaborate effectively across departments
* Experience with project management or collaboration tools; **Smartsheet and Microsoft Office Suite preferred**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* **PMP certification is a plus**

  

**Why This Role?**

This is an opportunity to build your project management career while gaining **broad exposure to how a business operates** . You won’t be confined to a single department or function. You’ll work with leaders and teams across the organization, tackle a variety of business challenges, and develop the skills needed to take on increasingly complex projects.  



  

If you’re organized, curious, collaborative, and energized by **making things happen** , we’d love to hear from you.  



  

Thank You for Your Interest and Consideration in a Career with Zep!


www.zep.com  



  

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.


**Our Values**

At Zep, we have developed a set of values focused on bringing even greater cohesion to our workplace. As part of this plan, we introduced a values framework called S.P.E.E.D. to align with our purpose of making the planet cleaner, safer, and more productive.


* **Stewardship:** We continuously improve the safety of our people and products, and we protect the planet by innovating solutions to reduce our environmental impact.
* **Passion for Problem Solving** : We listen to our customers and actively work to find solutions for unique situations. We think creatively to innovate and seize opportunities that will drive growth and make all our customers’ and consumers

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and opportunity to directly contribute to the companies' success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in several ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking, and work\-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim's high regard for our employees.


The Inside Sales Representative is responsible for generating sales and market share growth and enhance profitability with assigned veterinary clinics and customers. This role focuses on managing and expanding existing accounts as well acquiring new accounts. The position holder accomplishes this through virtual sales calls, proactive communication, and strategic planning. The incumbent is responsible for building strong relationships with all the key customer stakeholders as well as responsible for virtual Boehringer technical product and sales training of account staff.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------


Sales Development:


* Identifies and pursues sales opportunities virtually with accounts.
* Develops and maintains a pipeline of prospective accounts.
* Meets sales objectives and supports attainment of business unit performance objectives.
* Completes objectives including achieving sales plan while operating within specified expense budget.
  

  

Account Management and Engagement:


* Develops an excellent knowledge base of all assigned clinics, including the products they stock, their business objectives, their decision\-making processes, the key staff members, and technology footprint.
* Addresses customer inquiries, resolves issues and provides appropriate solutions to meet their needs.
* Tracks and analyzes account performance, providing insights and recommendations to improve sales outcomes.
* Within each clinic, identifies key clinic team members and builds relationships with the decision\-makers and staff, understanding their goals, challenges and needs.
* Conducts regular virtual calls with customers to nurture relationships and identify additional sales opportunities.
* Organizes, participates, and leads virtual events, webinars, and meetings to promote Boehringer's products and services.
* Keeps all business plans up to date on an ongoing basis, sharing its content with appropriate Pet and cross functional team members.
  

  

Sales Strategy:


* Analyzes account information to optimize customer calls and create annual business plan for execution.
* Executes business plan that incorporates sales strategies and tactics to achieve individual and team sales goals.
* Monitors market conditions and competitive activities for changes that impact the business and adjust business plan and sales strategies appropriately.
* Utilizes highly effective selling skills to convince customers to buy Boehringer products.
* Maintains and utilizes expert product knowledge and highly effective selling skills to influence customers to support the use of Boehringer promoted products.
* Executes brand strategies to ensure a consistent company sales and marketing message.
* Uses appropriate Boehringer sales training techniques to facilitate the sale.
  

  

Reporting and Administration:


* Utilizes CRM tools to create pre\-call plans.
* Keeps current account records concerning activities; communicates timely, accurately, and meaningfully with Management.
* Utilizes CRM tool and supporting analysis to plan activity, report, monitor samples and maintain customer records.
  

  

Market and Industry Knowledge:


* Responsible for development of market, customer, and industry knowledge along with further development of technical product knowledge is imperative.
* Ensures effective utilization and management of internal and external resources.
* Performs customer/consumer training meetings and supports convention and professional association business building opportunities.
**Requirements**
----------------


* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum of two to five (2\-5\) years of relevant sales experience in a competitive selling market in an Inside Sales environment.
* Animal Health or related industry experience preferred.
* Must demonstrate an aptitude and desire to sell and gain market share.
* Ability to work with general supervision in a matrix team environment.
* General knowledge of industry practices, techniques, and standards.
* Experience presenting to various size audiences.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills (verbal and written).
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong learning agility.
* Proficiency in various business software applications.
* Ability to travel occasionally.
  

  

**Eligibility Requirements** :


* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction.
* Must be willing to take a drug test and post\-offer physical (if required).
* Must be 18 years of age or older.
**Desired Skills, Experience and Abilities**
--------------------------------------------

**Sales Representative**


**Build Your Career With Purpose**


At POWER, sales is more than closing deals \- it's about helping homeowners make confident decisions while building a career with unlimited growth potential. As a full\-time Sales Representative you'll receive hands\-on training, mentorship, and the tools you need to develop professionally, earn uncapped commissions, and make an impact from day one.


**How you’ll make an impact**


* Meet with homeowners to deliver engaging presentations on our energy\-efficient home remodeling products and services.
* Learn POWER’s proven sales process through ongoing training and coaching.
* Build meaningful relationships with customers by understanding their needs and recommending personalized solutions.
* Collaborate with teammates and mentors to continuously improve your sales approach.
* Develop communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills that prepare you for long\-term career growth.

* Participate in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Contribute to a team culture built around mentorship, accountability, and celebrating success.


**What success looks like**


* Deliver exceptional customer experiences throughout every appointment.
* Consistently apply POWER’s sales process and product knowledge.
* Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to overall team success.
* Continue developing the skills needed for advancement within the organization.


**What It Takes To Succeed**


***You have these minimum qualifications:***


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence speaking with new people and presenting information.
* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.


***It would be helpful if you have:***


* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience delivering presentations or working toward performance\-based goals.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


At POWER, your success starts with our investment in you. From paid training and mentorship to comprehensive benefits and career advancement opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding long\-term career.


**Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy include:**


* **Competitive Earning Potential** \- Earn $72,000 \- $130,000 each year paid at an hourly rate which includes uncapped commissions and bonuses
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** \- Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance plans designed to support you and your family.
* **Retirement Savings** \- Build your future with a 401(k) plan that includes company matching.
* **Paid Time Away** \- Take advantage of paid holidays and paid parental leave so you can focus on what matters most.
* **Wellness Support** \- Access to wellness programs that help you stay at your best.
* **Professional Development** \- Receive industry\-leading training, mentorship, leadership development, and ongoing opportunities for career growth.
* **Performance Recognition** \- Celebrate your success with incentive vacations, exclusive rewards, and recognition for top performance.
* **Tools For Success** \- Work with modern technology and resources that help you serve customers and maximize your potential.
* **An Inclusive Culture** \- Join a team that values diverse perspectives, supports employee resource groups, encourages veterans to apply, and is committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
* **Community Impact** \- Give back through volunteer opportunities and company initiatives that make a positive impact in the communities we serve.
* **Modern Workspaces** \- Collaborate in thoughtfully designed office spaces with opportunities for relocation as your career grows.


**Office Locations**


* Duluth, GA
* Marietta, GA

  




* *Power offers a $3,900 sign\-on bonus, which will be paid weekly in $325 increments over the course of twelve weeks of initial training. The full sign\-on bonus is contingent on successfully completing the twelve weeks of initial training.*

new_jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

new_jobs.description:
**Social Media \& Content Marketing Manager**

Preferred Location: Chicago, IL area/ Hybrid  
Reports to: SVP, Brand \& Community Impact  
Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000

**About Planet Harvest**

Planet Harvest is a mission\-driven company working to maximize the value of the whole harvest. We partner with growers, food companies, corporations, and community organizations to create innovative solutions that reduce food waste, strengthen the food system and expand access to fresh food. Our work spans fresh food sourcing, whole harvest innovation, corporate partnerships, and community impact programs across the country.

**The Opportunity**

Planet Harvest is seeking a Social Media \& Content Marketing Manager to lead the day\-to\-day development and execution of our social media and content strategy.

This is a hands\-on role for a strong storyteller and content creator who can turn the work happening across Planet Harvest, from farms and food innovation to corporate partnerships and community impact, into compelling content that builds awareness, engagement and brand visibility. The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with a willingness to execute. This person will own the content calendar, manage Planet Harvest's social channels, create and capture content, support partner amplification, and help build a consistent and differentiated Planet Harvest brand presence.

This role reports to the SVP, Brand \& Community Impact and will work closely across the organization and with external partners.

**What You’ll Do**

Own Social Media \& Content

* Develop and manage Planet Harvest's social media and content strategy, with an initial focus on LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Own the editorial calendar, including planning, creating, scheduling and publishing content.
* Write compelling social copy and develop content across video, photography, graphics and other formats.
* Manage day\-to\-day community engagement and identify opportunities to grow Planet Harvest's audience and visibility.
* Stay current on social trends, platform changes and emerging content formats.

Bring the Planet Harvest Story to Life

* Identify and develop stories across Planet Harvest's work in agriculture, food, innovation, partnerships and community impact.
* Interview farmers, partners, employees and community organizations to uncover authentic stories and perspectives.
* Translate complex or behind\-the\-scenes work into accessible, engaging content.
* Develop stories that demonstrate Planet Harvest's impact and reinforce the company's broader brand positioning.
* Build and maintain a strong library of photo, video and storytelling assets.

Capture Content in the Field

* Develop content plans for key Planet Harvest events, farm visits, food distributions and partner activations.
* Attend select activations and events to personally capture photo, video and social content.
* Create timely, engaging content from the field while identifying opportunities for longer\-form and evergreen storytelling.

Support Marketing \& Partnerships

* Develop content that supports brand awareness, customer acquisition and strategic partnerships.
* Create social and communications toolkits that make it easy for corporate and community partners to amplify Planet Harvest initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for collaborative content, partner posts and executive amplification.
* Work closely with internal teams to ensure content supports company priorities and key initiatives.

Measure \& Optimize

* Track social media and content performance and establish regular reporting.
* Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement and content performance.
* Use data and insights to continuously improve content strategy and execution.
* Identify which stories, channels and formats are most effective in building awareness and engagement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4–7 years of experience in social media, content marketing, brand marketing, communications or a related field.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated experience managing brand social media channels, particularly LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Experience creating short\-form video, photography and visual social content.
* Ability to personally take content from idea through execution—from identifying the story and capturing assets to writing, publishing and measuring performance.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of what makes content engaging and shareable.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects, partners and deadlines.
* Self\-starter who can independently identify opportunities and move work forward.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Collaborative and comfortable working with a range of stakeholders, from farmers and nonprofit partners to corporate executives.
* Willingness to travel periodically for events, activations, farm visits and content capture.

**Nice to Have**

Experience in food, agriculture, sustainability, health and wellness, corporate social impact or purpose\-driven brands is a plus, as is experience with executive thought leadership, partner collaborations, PR, graphic design, photography or video editing.

**Who You Are**

You are a storyteller and a doer. You see the story before someone has to ask you to tell it. You are as comfortable developing a content strategy as you are capturing an iPhone video at an event, writing the caption and getting it published.

You are curious, creative and highly organized. You know how to take a big idea and turn it into content people actually want to engage with. You enjoy working across teams and with external partners, but you don't need a large team or agency to make things happen.

Most importantly, you are excited by the opportunity to help build the voice and visibility of a growing company working at the intersection of food, agriculture, innovation and community impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
